raw.description:
Job Type:

Term (Fixed Term)

Overview

RAND’s Center on AI, Security, and Technology (CAST), part of the Global and Emerging Risks (GER) Division conducts cutting-edge research on transformative, high-impact technologies—including artificial intelligence and biotechnology—to shape policies that protect global security and advance the public good.

Your work will address key questions related to global and emerging AI and biosecurity risks, understanding options for prevention and resilience, and examining their policy implications.

You will communicate the results of your work to both technical and non-technical audiences through quick-turnaround policy briefs and detailed written research products. A recent example of one of our research products is the Synthesis Screening report, which examined the current state of nucleic acid synthesis screening and offered recommendations for policymakers and industry leaders to further secure these technologies.

RAND's reputation for excellence is built on our commitment to high-quality, rigorous analysis and objectivity. In this role, you will apply quantitative and qualitative skills to rigorously analyze AI and biosecurity problems of national and international importance.

Qualifications

All research positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity.

In addition, successful applicants will have:

  • Experience in nucleic acid synthesis, AI-enabled biodesign, dual-use research of concern, potential pandemic pathogens, personal protective equipment, bioterrorism, or pathogen agnostic biosurveillance preferred.

  • Demonstrated knowledge and ability to analyze or implement policies involving strategy, doctrine, operations, tactics, systems or organization.

  • Ability for quantitative analysis and modeling, including modeling of uncertainty.

  • Experience in government, intelligence community, or other relevant decision-making offices preferred, but not required.

  • Ability to present evidence of research experience, demonstrated through authorship of academic publications, conference presentations, or prior professional reports.

Education & Experience Requirements

RAND is hiring multiple AI & Biosecurity Research Residents at the Associate, Specialist, and Expert levels of experience.

Minimum education and experience requirements at the Associate level include:

A PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Geology, or other natural and physical sciences is required – OR – PhD or equivalent in Policy Analysis or any technical discipline, Health Services Management, Public Health, Epidemiology or Business, with demonstrable proficiency in formal methods of decision support analysis is required.

OR

A Master’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, is required.

OR

A Bachelor’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience, is required.

Security Clearance

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government clearance is preferred but not required.

Location

We are hiring for this position in San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC; Santa Monica, CA; Pittsburgh, PA; and Boston, MA. We offer a hybrid work arrangement, combining work from home and on-site options. Fully remote work will also be considered.

Writing Sample

A writing sample of 3 pages or more is required for this position. Applicants are encouraged to use recent pieces that have been published in academic or other journals, but may use master’s theses or papers written for coursework, prior employment, or internships.

Term

This position is a 3-year term appointment with a possibility of renewal, alongside options for longer term employment.

Salary Range:

Biosecurity Resident, Associate = $126,400 - $183,300

Biosecurity Resident, Specialist = $145,600 - $227,600

Biosecurity Resident, Expert = $175,500 - $274,300

RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate’s work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. Successful candidates will be offered employment in a specific title, as determined by the candidate’s education and experience. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND’s sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

Role Title: App Security Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging App Security Experts to contribute to a customer’s dynamic project focused on real-world application security. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and implement small, purpose-built application fixtures with embedded security vulnerabilities or secure solutions, specifically addressing OWASP LLM risks such as Sensitive Information Disclosure and Excessive Agency.
  2. Develop deterministic test cases and security-context manifests to robustly assess application security posture.
  3. Create detailed hidden answer keys to enable accurate AI or scanner evaluation of vulnerable versus secure code.
  4. Evaluate and iterate on pipeline methodologies to ensure synthetic tasks and fixtures are challenging yet realistic for AppSec assessment.
  5. Document technical insights and methodologies, ensuring clarity in written feedback and communication.
  6. Collaborate through clear and thorough written and verbal communication to share findings and review peer contributions.
  7. Engage with agent-based security architecture and contribute to continuous improvement of the evaluation pipeline.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive experience (ideally 5+ years) in application security, secure software development, or CyberSWE roles.
  2. Strong understanding of OSWE, LLM security, AI-powered static analysis (AI-SAST), and AppSec best practices.
  3. Proven track record designing or evaluating security architecture for traditional and agent-based applications.
  4. Expertise in building, securing, and testing application codebases, including identifying and remediating advanced vulnerabilities.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on precise technical documentation and collaborative feedback.
  6. Experience with synthetic security fixtures and deterministic testing approaches is highly desirable.
  7. Demonstrated ability to deliver thoughtful insights and actionable security recommendations in a remote contribution context.

The ideal candidate possesses exceptional project management discipline, strong strategic planning and communication skills, and the ability to bridge sales, project, and technical teams.

For assigned programs, the responsibilities include 100% accountability for the oversight and successful delivery of projects. The role serves as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution and will coordinate all Clinisys team resources.

Clinisys’ AI Philosophy:

Building an AI first organization is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we develop AI enabled, cloud-based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier, safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. Every team member must help drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.

Clinisys Professional Services:

With a passion for action and a future-first mindset, the Clinisys Professional Services team operates at the intersection of human ingenuity and intelligent technology. We harness relentless curiosity, imaginative innovation, and AI-powered insight to move beyond incremental progress and design what comes next. We focus on what should be possible, not just what’s technically available today—and we hold ourselves to the highest standards of excellence. This ethos has brought together a world-class ecosystem of builders, thinkers, and doers who aren’t simply adopting the future—they’re actively engineering it.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive project and program plans, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths, ensuring full alignment with Statement of Work (SOW), scope, timelines, and contracted deliverables

  • Manage delivery rigorously against approved plans, maintaining clear visibility into budget, schedule, scope, and contractual obligations throughout the project lifecycle

  • Establish and maintain strong, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, including executive leaders, counterpart program and project managers, engineering, development, security, and operations teams.

  • Ensure customers clearly understand their roles, responsibilities, dependencies, and required inputs to enable timely and successful delivery

  • Lead and facilitate project kickoffs, recurring status meetings, executive briefings, milestone reviews, and steering committee sessions with both customer and internal stakeholders

  • Proactively identify and manage dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues; maintain actionable mitigation and contingency plans and drive timely resolution

  • Provide end‑to‑end leadership for AI solution delivery, spanning discovery, solution design, implementation, deployment, and optimization within complex enterprise environments

  • Identify potential scope deviations early and collaborate with Sales and Professional Services leadership to manage change requests and formal change order processes

  • Orchestrate a seamless transition to the Customer Success organization at project completion, ensuring full knowledge transfer, documentation handoff, and alignment on success criteria

  • Lead post‑project retrospectives and lessons‑learned sessions to drive continuous improvement across delivery processes, tools, and engagement models

  • All other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Skills Needed to Be Successful:

  • Executive Presence & Communication -Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with expert ability to articulate complex ideas, risks, and recommendations clearly and confidently to technical teams, business partners, and executive leadership which will be validated by the ability to work effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders and the navigation of competing priorities

  • Project Planning & Execution -Advanced proficiency with industry-standard project management tools and techniques, including the development of detailed, integrated project plans, schedules, dependencies, risk management strategies and clear documentation maintained throughout the project

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Capabilities -Highly developed analytical skills, demonstrated through the ability to diagnose issues, identify improvement opportunities, and develop actionable, results-oriented plans.

  • Process Development & Continuous Improvement -Experience designing, implementing, and institutionalizing formal project and program management processes to improve consistency, transparency, and delivery outcomes.

  • AI Tools Utilization & Prompting Excellence – Demonstrated ability to effectively leverage AI‑enabled tools to enhance program planning, delivery execution, risk analysis, stakeholder communications, and decision‑making. Skilled in advanced prompting techniques to obtain accurate, relevant, and actionable outputs from AI systems, with a strong understanding of responsible AI use, data privacy considerations, and change management implications within enterprise and regulated environments.

  • Software Development & Delivery Excellence -Deep knowledge of modern software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, DevOps) and associated tools. Demonstrated ability to apply best practices to improve development efficiency, quality, and scalability.

  • Technical & Architectural Expertise -Proven experience delivering solutions built on industry‑standard technologies, operating platforms, and modern development frameworks. Strong technical acumen with the ability to critically evaluate designs, challenge assumptions, and guide experienced teams.

  • Strong, positive feedback from internal stakeholders regarding program leadership, collaboration, decision‑making, and clarity of communication

raw.description:
This is a fully remote, US-based position, open tocandidates residing in the New Jersey

About Us

For 40 years, Encore Corporate Travel has helped CFOs, CPOs, and travel leaders reimagine business travel—simpler, smarter, and more personal.

With 24/7 Traveler Services, proprietary technology, proactive program management, and integrated Meetings & Events, Encore delivers clarity, control, and care across every experience.

As a proudly woman-owned, independent company, Encore moves fast, solves harder problems, and grows with intention, never compromising on the personalized service that sets it apart.

A VIP travelerdoes not want to be asked twice.

The windowseat booked without a reminder. The hotel loyalty number applied before theythink to mention it. The connection they hate, avoided on instinct becausesomeone remembered the last three times it went wrong. That is not service.That is being known, and it is the difference between an agent and a resource.

VIP CorporateTravel Agents at Encore exist because being known does not happen by accident.Dedicated and complex accounts do not land with this role because policyrequires it. They land because the traveler learned, itinerary after itinerary,that their preferences are never an afterthought here.

The Role

As a VIP Corporate Travel Agent, you manage new bookings and changes across air, hotel, rail, and car for Encore's most demanding travel clients: name changes, date shifts, itinerary rebuilds, all handled inside the client's travel policy and inside the traveler's expectations. You carry sensitive, private information with the same care every time, not just when someone is watching.

This is not a booking role. It is a relationship role wearing an agent's title.

What You'll Do

Own every VIP itinerary, start to finish. You book and rebuild international air, hotel, rail, and car reservations, and you do it fluently in the loyalty programs that matter to the traveler holding the ticket.

Protect what's sensitive and keep it compliant. You complete document verification and pre-check for every traveler in your care, advise on entry requirements before they're asked about, and keep every reservation inside the client's policy without being told twice.

Anticipate before they ask. You learn each traveler's preferences and hold them across every booking. An air request with a night away from home is an opening to offer the right hotel, not an afterthought. You close the loop other agents leave open.

Raise the standard for the team. You're a resource to your colleagues, not just your travelers. You answer questions before they're fully asked, and you share the tips and tricks that turn a good file into a clean one. Dedicated and complex accounts land with you because that reputation is earned, one file at a time.


Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • Extensivetravel industry experience (20+ years), with demonstrated expertise in US domestic travel, international itineraries, fare rules, and loyalty program mechanics
  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Advanced, current knowledge of travel industry rules and processes, including document requirements and entry rules that shift by destination
  • The soft skills to guide a traveler to resolution in the fewest exchanges possible, and the persuasive, precise writing to do the same with colleagues and other teams
  • A customer orientation strong enough to build lasting relationships with travelers who do not tolerate friction
  • Ownership of mistakes: you correct them without waiting to be asked
  • The organizational discipline to manage multiple complex or dedicated accounts at once without missing a detail, and to meet service level agreements on every interaction

An asset

  • Formal travel school training
  • Prior experience supporting dedicated or high-complexity accounts specifically
  • Deep knowledge of US-based corporate travel programs and compliance requirements

Shift Options

Available schedules (Eastern Time):

  • Monday to Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET
  • Monday to Friday: 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET

Who Thrives Here

The travelers Encore's VIP agents serve are busy, well-informed, and unforgiving of friction. They will not explain their preferences twice. They want someone who already has the answer ready, not someone still looking for it.

The agents who thrive in this role take that personally, in the best way. They close a file only when it's actually closed. They treat a colleague's question as worth answering fully, because the next complex account might land on that colleague's desk instead of theirs.

If precision and anticipation are how you measure a good day at work, this is where that gets rewarded.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Business Development Representative

Club OS One

THE COMPANY

ClubOS One is a fast-growing, all-in-one gym management software platform designed to streamline operations, increase member engagement, and drive revenue growth for fitness clubs of all sizes. We combine CRM, member sign-ups, billing, scheduling, and payment processing into one powerful, user-friendly solution. As we expand our footprint in the fitness tech space, we're looking for passionate professionals ready to help gyms thrive.

POSITION

The Business Development Representative (BDR) supports the Sales organization by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective sales opportunities before transitioning qualified opportunities to the appropriate Sales Representative.

The BDR serves as an important first point of contact for prospective clients and plays a key role in building a healthy sales pipeline. This position is responsible for understanding a prospect's business needs, determining their level of interest and sales readiness, gathering relevant information, and ensuring the Sales team receives well-qualified opportunities with the information needed to move efficiently through the sales process.

In addition to new business opportunities, the BDR supports Back to Base initiatives by identifying and qualifying opportunities within the existing client base for additional products and services.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Respond to and engage assigned leads through telephone, email, and other approved communication channels.
  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand the prospect's business, needs, challenges, current solutions, decision-making process, and level of interest.
  • Qualify prospective opportunities using established criteria to determine fit and sales readiness.
  • Schedule qualified prospects with the appropriate Sales Representative and provide a clear, complete handoff of information gathered during the qualification process.
  • Maintain consistent and timely follow-up with leads that require additional nurturing before they are ready to engage with Sales.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting activities as assigned to identify and develop new potential business opportunities.
  • Support Back to Base sales initiatives by reviewing existing client accounts and identifying opportunities for additional products, services, or solutions.
  • Contact existing clients as part of Back to Base campaigns to determine interest, business need, and readiness for additional solutions before transitioning qualified opportunities to Sales.
  • Develop a working knowledge of company products, services, pricing structure, target markets, and ideal customer profiles to effectively identify potential opportunities.
  • Accurately document prospect and client interactions, qualification information, follow-up activities, and outcomes within HubSpot and other designated systems.
  • Maintain accurate lead statuses and ensure opportunities are appropriately progressed, nurtured, disqualified, or transitioned based on established processes.
  • Partner closely with assigned Sales Representatives to understand priorities, target opportunities, qualification expectations, and feedback regarding lead quality.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Customer Success, and other internal teams when opportunities or relevant client information are identified.
  • Meet established performance expectations related to outreach activity, response time, qualified opportunities, scheduled meetings, lead conversion, and Back to Base initiatives.
  • Participate in sales training, coaching, team meetings, and ongoing product education to continuously improve sales development skills and product knowledge.
  • Provide feedback regarding common prospect questions, objections, competitive information, and market trends identified through conversations.
  • Represent the company professionally and create a positive experience during every prospect and client interaction.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous experience in business development, inside sales, lead generation, customer service, account management, or a related customer-facing role preferred.
  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology, payments, fitness, or business-to-business environment is preferred.
  • Experience working with CRM systems such as HubSpot is preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly.
  • Ability to ask effective discovery questions and actively listen to understand business needs.
  • Comfortable conducting outbound telephone and email outreach to prospective and existing clients.
  • Ability to recognize potential sales opportunities without prematurely advancing unqualified leads.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple leads and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to learn and communicate the value of multiple products and services.
  • Comfortable working toward measurable activity and performance goals.
  • Ability to receive coaching, incorporate feedback, and continuously improve.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate CRM records.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Sales and other departments while maintaining clear ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to remain persistent and professional when prospects are difficult to reach or initially uninterested.

Business Unit:

Club OS One

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.description:
HistoSonics is a commercial-stage medtech company advancing the Edison® System, a novel non-invasive sonic beam therapy based on histotripsy. Since receiving FDA De Novo grant for the non-invasive destruction of liver tumors in 2023, the company has progressed beyond initial market entry into commercial expansion, reimbursement momentum, and ongoing clinical and pipeline development. In addition to its current liver tumor indication, HistoSonics is pursuing future indications across multiple applications including kidney, pancreas, prostate, neuro, women’s health, and other significant underserved human health areas, to realize the broader potential histotripsy across multiple disease states and medical specialties.

We offer an exciting work culture where cutting-edge science meets real-world application, and each team member’s contribution is important to our success in ensuring our physicians and their patients get what they need most.

Location:Remote - Houston, TX

Travel Requirement: Up to 70% travel with overnight stays required.

Position Summary (Why this role matters):

The Physician Training Specialist is responsible for delivering high-quality, hands-on technology and clinical education to physicians and other healthcare professionals learning to use the Edison® HistoSonics Histotripsy System.

This is a customer-facing role for an exceptional clinical educator who can establish credibility with experienced physicians, master complex medical technology, and translate sophisticated clinical and technical concepts into clear, practical instruction. The ideal candidate combines deep ultrasound or imaging expertise with outstanding facilitation, coaching, and hands-on training skills.

Key Responsibilities (What you’ll do):

  • Deliver physician education through the established HistoSonics professional education pathway, including didactic instruction, hands-on system training, ultrasound education, simulation, case-based learning, observation, and other experiential learning activities.
  • Educate physicians on Edison System technology, functionality, setup, operation, treatment planning concepts, procedural workflow, and appropriate use of the technology.
  • Provide expert hands-on ultrasound education focused on image acquisition, image optimization, anatomy identification, treatment planning, and image-guided workflows.
  • Adapt instruction based on physician specialty, clinical experience, technical proficiency, and demonstrated understanding while maintaining established learning objectives and training standards.
  • Provide clear, actionable coaching and feedback that builds physician knowledge, confidence, and proficiency with HistoSonics technology.
  • Develop and maintain expert-level knowledge of the Edison System, software, accessories, ultrasound integration, imaging principles, treatment workflow, and associated clinical workflows.
  • Troubleshoot common system, ultrasound, and training-environment challenges and appropriately escalate technical or clinical concerns.
  • Facilitate physician programs, workshops, simulation labs, case observations, and faculty-led educational experiences at HistoSonics and regional training locations.
  • Partner with physician faculty and cross-functional teams to deliver a consistent, engaging, and clinically credible physician learning experience.

Competencies:

  • Demonstrate strong clinical knowledge and advanced ultrasound or imaging expertise relevant to image-guided procedures.
  • Translate anatomy, imaging, procedural workflow, and treatment-planning concepts into practical physician instruction.
  • Quickly develop and maintain expert-level understanding of complex medical technology, software, imaging systems, and associated workflows.
  • Confidently operate, demonstrate, and troubleshoot sophisticated technology in a hands-on training environment.
  • Adjust instructional approach in real time based on learner needs while maintaining program standards and objectives.
  • Establish trust with physicians and healthcare professionals through clinical depth, preparation, communication, and sound judgment.
  • Prepare and execute complex physician training programs with strong attention to detail, equipment readiness, documentation, and consistency.
  • Support trainer calibration and standardization to ensure high-quality experience across instructors and training locations.
  • Partner effectively with Professional Education, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Sales, Procedure Development, R&D, and physician faculty.
  • Communicate learner, faculty, and field insights that can strengthen physician education programs and resources.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Exceptional presentation, facilitation, coaching, and communication skills with physician and clinical audiences.
  • Strong clinical acumen with demonstrated ability to teach ultrasound, imaging concepts, anatomy, and procedural workflows.
  • Ability to translate complex clinical and technical concepts into clear, practical instruction.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and program execution capabilities with consistent attention to detail.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning principles, competency-based education, and hands-on or experiential learning methodologies.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in nursing, allied health, life sciences, or a related clinical field; equivalent relevant clinical education and experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in clinical education, medical device training, clinical practice, healthcare delivery, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ultrasound experience and ability to independently teach ultrasound principles, image acquisition, optimization, anatomy recognition, and image-guided workflows strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience educating physicians or other healthcare professionals in a procedural or technology-based environment.
  • Experience in interventional radiology, surgery, operating room, imaging, or another image-guided procedural setting.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn, operate, troubleshoot, and teach complex medical technology.
  • RDMS or another ultrasound-specific clinical credential strongly preferred.

raw.description:
Pan-American Life Insurance Group (PALIG) is seeking a Regional Sales Vice President (RSVP) within the US Group Benefits division who will be responsible for building relationships with sales distribution partners consisting primarily of Individual Independent Producers and Regional Brokerage Firms, and achieving distribution contact activity targets through the development and execution of marketing strategies/plans that advance the PALIG brand, product portfolio and service platform. The position will be charged with proactively building sustainable relationships that promote sales to employer group markets.


ESSENTIAL FUNCITONS:

Business Development & Strategic Partnerships:

  • Develop profitable new business opportunities and maintain existing business relationships.
  • Identify, build and manage relationships with benefit consultants, brokers and enrollment firms to expand the Pan-American presence in their business processes.
  • Serve as the executive relationship manager.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior management, home office staff, and field sales staff and assist them in building working relationships with consultants/agents/brokers/enrollment entities and PALIG’s divisional partners in understanding the needs of our customers and executing sales strategies to fulfill those needs while providing growth and profitability to PALIG.

Sales Reporting & CRM Management:

  • Provide reporting to Senior Management as requested.
  • Maintain CRM data base with required current, accurate account and producer information

Marketing Strategy & Market Intelligence:

  • Develop and execute both short- and long-term marketing strategies/business plans for the promotion of PALIG products and services to increase sales of producer partner business.
  • Keep current on business, competitor and market trends and incorporate that knowledge into strategies and initiatives, maintaining focus on continuous improvement through researching innovative, and cost-efficient business solutions.

Client Events & Professional Representation:

  • Represent PALIG at client meetings, industry events, networking functions, and business development activities.
  • Participate in client lunches, dinners, and other relationship-building events as needed.
  • Maintain a professional presence that strengthens the company's reputation and market position.

Other Duties as Assigned


KEY REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS:

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 additional years of relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of degree
  • 10 years of experience in technical sales, sales management and working with national benefit brokerage, benefit consulting firms, and benefit communications and technology firms.
  • 5 years broker/agency experience required; worksite and/or supplemental insurance experience preferred, with emphasis on large case (500+ employees) and interaction with large national brokerage and consulting firms and benefit communication (enrollment & technology) firms.
  • Advanced knowledge of individual and group insurance product, as well as payroll allotment and IRSC 125, and workplace/voluntary benefit experience.
  • Active Domiciled State Life & Health License
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including frequent client luncheons, dinners and events
  • Bi-lingual Spanish / English preferred
  • A valid driver’s license
  • 75% travel requirement within defined geography

Succes Factors:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Practical, positive and quick thinker
  • Have the expertise to provide solutions with creative ideas
  • Ability to work at a fast pace and handle challenging obstacles
  • Detail oriented
  • Excellent organization and time management skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively collaborate with internal departments and outside vendors.
  • Basic Math skills required

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package (base salary & bonus incentive)
  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, 401(k), paid time off, and tuition reimbursement
  • Medical and dental coverage effective the first of the month following 30 days of service
  • Remote / Hybrid work opportunities

About Us:

Pan-American Life Insurance Group (PALIG) serves the life, accident, and health insurance needs of individuals and businesses across 49 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands through its U.S.-based member companies—Pan-American Life Insurance Company and Pan-American Assurance Company.


At PALIG, our employees are our greatest asset. We value collaboration, trust, and the confidence of our policyholders. Our long-standing commitment to excellence continues to drive our success.

raw.title: Senior WAN Financial & Program Analyst – Network Services
raw.excerpt: At Ford, we are the movers of the world and the makers of the future.
raw.description:
At Ford, we are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. We get up every day, roll up our sleeves, and build a better world—together. At Ford, we’re all part of something bigger than ourselves. Are you ready to help change the way the world moves?

Do you believe reliable, cost-effective connectivity is essential to keeping a global business moving? Ford’s Network Services organization supports critical operations through global WAN and carrier services. Strong financial management, supplier performance, and cross-functional coordination help ensure those services meet business needs while delivering value.

We are seeking a Senior WAN Financial & Program Analyst to support the financial, supplier, and operational management of Ford’s global WAN and carrier services. In this role, you will partner with Network Engineering, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and strategic suppliers to improve cost visibility, strengthen supplier performance, and support reliable connectivity for Ford’s global operations.

This role combines financial analysis, supplier and contract coordination, program support, and stakeholder communication. You will help manage budgets and forecasts, track carrier services and commitments, identify cost-optimization opportunities, and support network transformation initiatives.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Governance

  • Manage financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and reporting for global WAN and carrier services.
  • Support WAN financial governance, including purchase orders, invoice tracking, budget reconciliation, forecasting, and supplier-spend oversight.
  • Develop and maintain financial reports, cost-allocation models, operational dashboards, and executive-level presentations.
  • Analyze costs, commitments, and financial trends to identify risks, variances, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide stakeholders with clear visibility into budgets, supplier spend, financial commitments, and forecast assumptions.
  • Partner with Finance and Network Services teams to support financial controls and improve reporting processes.

Supplier, Contract & Carrier Management

  • Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Network Engineering, and Operations to manage supplier budgets, contracts, and performance.
  • Support carrier contract renewals, circuit demand planning, and commercial activities.
  • Track WAN circuit inventory, service delivery, financial commitments, and supplier performance.
  • Coordinate with carriers and service providers to drive service improvements and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support stakeholder communications and supplier coordination during major network service disruptions.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, service quality, and supplier accountability.

Program Coordination & Network Transformation

  • Support global WAN transformation initiatives through financial analysis, supplier coordination, project tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Network Engineering, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and external suppliers.
  • Track deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions that could affect financial or program outcomes.
  • Support clear communication of initiative status, financial impacts, supplier actions, and key milestones.
  • Help improve processes for circuit demand planning, inventory tracking, financial reporting, and supplier coordination.

We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you bring strong financial and analytical skills, supplier-management experience, and an interest in supporting global network services, we encourage you to apply.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Technology Management, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in financial management, supplier management, contract administration, technology program management, or a related role.
  • Experience with financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience managing or tracking supplier performance, contracts, purchase orders, invoices, or financial commitments.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information to senior leaders.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large data sets.

Required Technical Experience

  • Strong analytical and financial-planning skills, with the ability to assess spend, forecasts, variances, and commitments.
  • Experience preparing financial reports, dashboards, cost models, or executive presentations.
  • Experience coordinating across Finance, Supply Chain, technical teams, operations, and external suppliers.
  • Ability to organize and interpret complex financial, supplier, inventory, and service-delivery information.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain financial and operational information clearly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including working with large data sets.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with telecommunications, WAN, networking, carrier services, or infrastructure operations.
  • Experience with supplier contract management, sourcing, procurement, or commercial activities.
  • Knowledge of circuit inventory management, telecom expense management, and carrier billing.
  • Familiarity with telecom financial concepts, including recurring and non-recurring charges, service commitments, and contract renewals.
  • Experience supporting large-scale global technology environments or infrastructure transformation initiatives.
  • Experience developing cost-allocation models, operational dashboards, or supplier-performance reporting.
  • Familiarity with Python, Power BI, FlowCraft, Alteryx, or other analytics and automation tools.

What You’ll Bring

A combination of business acumen, financial discipline, supplier-management expertise, analytical capability, and program-coordination skills to help deliver reliable, cost-effective global network services that support Ford’s business worldwide.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members, and management leases
  • Tuition assistance
  • Established and active employee resource groups
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

For a detailed look at our benefits, click here:Benefit Summary

This position is a salary grade8.

This position is a salary grade 8and ranges from $99,100-$166,200.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

raw.description:
As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer - VoIP Infrastructure you will:

  • Contribute to the design, development and implementation of VoIP infrastructure, telephony platforms, and observability features that power AI-driven voice workloads
  • Collaborate with engineering, Product, and infrastructure teams to ensure our voice and AI platforms perform efficiently, scale reliably, and integrate seamlessly across SIP/RTP, Kamailio, RTPEngine, and related telecom systems.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the SRE practice by turning operational telephony and AI workload use cases into requirements for software tooling.
  • Contribute to the execution of deployment and support activities for VoIP systems and AI/ML developers operating in production voice environments.
  • Build high-quality, clean, scalable and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit testing, etc.).
  • Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation, and delivery — spanning both telephony infrastructure and LLM integration layers.
  • Experience integrating LLMs into voice platforms and real-time communication systems.
  • Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge-sharing across telecom and AI engineering disciplines.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Hands-on experience building VoIP systems using SIP/RTP protocols;  
  • Practical knowledge of Kamailio, RTPEngine, FreeSWITCH, SBCs, and PSTN systems (or similar);
  • Working knowledge of PSTN infrastructure and telecom protocols;
  • Experience integrating applications on top of LLMs (using existing models, not building them);
  • Experience in prompt engineering and developing LLM based features 
  • 4+ years of development experience with Python, GoLang, Java or similar languages. 
  • 4+ years of experience operating highly available distributed workloads on Kubernetes following a DevOps approach. 
  • Working experience building distributed systems with cloud-native software; 
  • Experience with software-defined networking, infrastructure as code and configuration management;
  • Experience with DevOps tooling  (e.g. Helm / Ansible / Kubernetes / Prometheus /Splunk/ GitLab CI) is considered an asset
  • Experience building software for compliance and security in regulated environments is considered an asset
  • 4+ years of experience with infrastructure and platform operations, deployments, SRE, and DevOps with a continued focus on improving Platform health is considered an asset

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $176,100 - $308,200, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

  • Fluent English with a clear, neutral accent
  • Spanish is a strong advantage
  • Ability to work U.S. Pacific Time (PST) hours
  • Reliable high-speed internet, headset, and quiet work environment
  • Comfortable with high-volume cold calling
  • Highly coachable and receptive to feedback through call reviews
  • Strong work ethic and consistency in hitting performance metrics

Nice to have:

  • Background in solar, home services, or call centers
  • Strong objection handling and rapport-building skills
  • Experience working in remote, KPI-driven environments

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

Kaplan delivers innovative interventions and prep programs that help students advance their education to realize their potential. Our team uses teaching methods based on carefully curated curriculum and score-boosting strategies and delivers unparalleled practice that adapts to the Learner.

This role sets architectural direction, evaluates technologies that strengthen our products, and coaches and mentors others to a higher level. The Architect also leads the team’s adoption of AI-driven development, applying the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), large language models (LLMs), and AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while maintaining architectural quality and human oversight.


The Architect partners with product management, application management, operations, fellow architects, and development team leads in strategic, tactical, and design planning.


What your impact will be:

  • Set the architectural vision and milestones for teams building highly scalable Java and web-based applications.
  • Lead the adoption of AI-driven development practices, including the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), and define how AI coding agents such as Claude Code are used across the inception, construction, and operational phases.
  • Establish standards for reviewing, testing, and validating AI-generated code and design artifacts to ensure quality, security, and maintainability.
  • Evaluate and architect solutions that integrate large language models (LLMs) into MEDHOST products and internal workflows, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Employ the existing architectural stack and collaborate with the rest of the enterprise to evolve it.
  • Review and approve technical designs to ensure the architectural integrity of the system, and help teams deliver according to development standards.
  • Participate in the complete software development lifecycle within an Agile process, from requirements through testing and deployment.
  • Plan for performance requirements, set performance targets, and troubleshoot production bottlenecks, including JVM, application server, and database performance.

  • Meet with clients and internal users to determine long-term system needs and requirements that support the company’s business objectives and external client interface requirements.

  • Coach and mentor team members (regardless of role: developer, tester, or product manager) on the appropriate use of technology to address customer and business needs.

What we look for:

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science or an Engineering field.
  • 4 years of development experience; or a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or an Engineering field and 6 years of development experience, with significant hands-on Java experience.
  • Significant technical leadership experience and maturity.
  • Hands-on experience applying the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) or similar AI-native development methodologies to production software.
  • Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), including prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and integrating LLM APIs into applications.
  • Experience using Claude Code or comparable AI coding agents in day-to-day development, including configuring project context and guiding agents through structured, reviewable workflows.
  • Experience designing and implementing a highly available environment, as well as the nuances of a clustered solution.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure aspects (server, middleware, and network) of web-based applications.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the demonstrable ability to communicate appropriately at all levels of the organization, including written and verbal communication and documentation ranging from whiteboards to architecture diagrams.
  • Strong understanding of database concepts including design, implementation, support, and performance optimization.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-based systems.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with some or all of the following:

o AI: Claude Code, LLM APIs, AI-DLC

o Server side: Java (JDK 17+), Spring Framework / Spring Boot (DI, REST, AOP, Spring
Security), Tomcat, RHEL.

o Client side: Angular, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript

o Data: DB2 on IBM i (AS/400 / Power Systems), SQL.

o Tools: IntelliJ IDEA, Maven or Gradle, JUnit.

  • DB2 / AS/400 / Power Systems experience and understanding a plus, as the application is backed by DB2 / AS/400 / Power Systems.

What We Offer:

With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

Job Title

Senior Materials Characterization Support Specialist (REMOTE US or CAN)


Location(s)

US Remote - AL, US Remote - AL, US Remote - AR, US Remote - AZ, US Remote - CO, US Remote - CT, US Remote - DC, US Remote - DE, US Remote - FL, US Remote - GA, US Remote - IA, US Remote - ID, US Remote - IL, US Remote - IN, US Remote - KS, US Remote - KY, US Remote - LA, US Remote - MA, US Remote - MD, US Remote - ME, US Remote - MI, US Remote - MN, US Remote - MO, US Remote - MS, US Remote - MT {+ 25 more}

Job Description

The Senior Materials Characterization Support Specialist serves as a remote technical expert supporting PerkinElmer’s customers, field service engineers, and internal stakeholders throughout North America. This role is responsible for the rapid triage, diagnosis, and resolution of complex hardware, software, and application-related issues across supported Materials Characterization platforms.


Operating as part of the Technical Assistance Center (TAC), this position plays a critical role in maximizing customer instrument uptime, avoiding unnecessary field service visits, enabling first-time-fix outcomes, and delivering a consistently high-quality customer experience. The specialist applies deep technical knowledge, strong diagnostic reasoning, and the ability to visualize systems remotely—often without direct access to the instrument—to resolve known, repeat, and novel issues.


Location: This is a full-time remote position M-F and can be done either in US or CAN.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary technical contact for incoming customer, field engineer, and internal support inquiries via phone and email for PerkinElmer Materials Characterization products. Triage requests ranging from basic product information to highly complex service and performance issues involving hardware, software, consumables, or methodology.
  • Perform detailed remote diagnostics of complex electro/mechanical equipment and computer/software systems by interpreting user descriptions, symptoms, error messages, system logs, and/or user generated data.
  • Drive issue resolution toward the most efficient and timely outcome: remote fix where possible, or a well-prepared service event where required. When remote resolution is achievable, guide customers or colleagues through corrective actions to restore performance and uptime.
  • When field service is required, determine likely root cause(s), recommend corrective actions, identify required parts, and document a clear plan of action to enable first-time-fix. If applicable to customer entitlement status, provide professional, accurate quotations for billable services and/or escalate leads for other PE products/services to appropriate internal teams.
  • Serve as a mentor and technical resource for colleagues by acting as liaison between global technical services, training teams, and the North American service organization to disseminate product updates, service notices, lessons learned, and other best practices.
  • Support operational excellence by adhering to documented procedures and maintaining accurate, complete, and timely service records. Ensure documentation quality enables effective handoffs, trend analysis, and timely escalation of emerging issues.
  • Participate in company offered training and development programs to support continuous improvement of technical expertise and soft skills. Training formats may include virtual or live classroom training, hands-on service location visits, field engineer shadowing, and travel as needed
  • Support additional cross-functional or special initiatives based on business needs as interest and workload allow. Contribute expertise in areas such as training/mentoring, SOP/documentation improvement, and/or data analysis.
  • Maintain training and compliance in areas of health and safety, security, environmental and operational aspects of daily activities in the working environment.

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job at any time.

Critical Skills:

  • Sound technical knowledge in all Materials Characterization product lines supported, including applications knowledge, and including proficiency in all software platforms of associated supported equipment.
  • Ability to apply sound judgment and critical‑thinking skills to complex technical problems, using structured, stepwise diagnostic reasoning and root‑cause analysis, with the ability to mentally model and visualize system behavior without direct access to guide effective remote troubleshooting and resolution.
  • Ability to safely and professionally execute technical work in accordance with written and verbal instructions, including interpreting technical bulletins and service manuals, working effectively under time constraints, maintaining focus and situational awareness, and adhering to universal precautions when working with potential electrical, chemical, radiologic, and biologic hazards.
  • Proficiency with standard computing tools to document work, analyze information, and generate reports, along with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively with customers, peers, managers, and other technical support professionals.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Biology, Chemistry, Electronics, or related discipline
  • MUST have expert level experience with Materials Characterization Instrumentation on a repair level as a Subject Matter Expert (5+ years)
  • 5+ years' experience with at least two (2) of the following product technologies: FT-IR, UV-Vis, TEA
  • Role requires 5+ years of experience in a support, service, or an analytical laboratory environment performing duties of a product end user or service technician using Materials Characterization instrumentation.
  • Must be able to travel up to 25% for training (in the USA) and for quarterly field ridealongs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ten (10) years experience in a support, service, or an analytical laboratory environment performing duties of a product end user or service technician using Materials Characterization instrumentation. Experience with all three (3) of the following product technologies: FT-IR, UV-Vis, TEA, is desired
  • Certification through company‑provided training on PerkinElmer instrumentation and software products, or equivalent hands‑on professional experience supporting PerkinElmer systems, is desired.

Working Environment:

  • Primary work environment is a home office or office based setting, supporting customers remotely via phone, email, and computer based systems for a majority of the role.
  • Work is primarily sedentary and computer focused, requiring extended periods of concentration, phone communication, and use of standard office equipment. Must be able to remain in a stationary position more than 25% of the time
  • Job pace may be fast moving, with periods of high workload depending on customer demand and escalations.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include without limitation, the ability to observe details at close range distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus in order to perform the essential service functions of this position.
  • Occasional travel may be required for training, team meetings, or visits to customer sites or company training facilities. During these activities, work may take place in laboratory or controlled environments requiring the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as lab coats and safety glasses.
  • When present in laboratory or service locations, the role may involve: 1) Moving between labs, corridors, and adjoining rooms, 2) Standing, bending, squatting, stretching, reaching, or working with instruments, tools, or controls, 3) Lifting or moving items typically up to 25 pounds, with infrequent lifting of heavier items as needed
  • Potential exposure to laboratory hazards including chemicals, biological materials, temperature extremes, or regulated waste may occur during training or site visits. All activities are performed in accordance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations.
  • Depending on assignment, employees may be required to complete medical clearance, respiratory protection training, and fit testing to support work in controlled environments during training or onsite activities.

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $82,000 to $105,000 USD. The final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

PerkinElmer is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. PerkinElmer is committed to a culturally diverse workforce.

We are seeking an Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Developer to build and maintain enterprise-grade digital experiences on AEM Sites, AEM Assets, and AEM as a Cloud Service. The role focuses on hands-on development of components, templates, workflows, integrations, and front-end experiences using AEM’s modern stack, with strong attention to performance, content authoring experience, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful AEM work in production, understands modern AEM patterns including SPA editor and headless delivery, and balances technical rigor with editor and content-author needs.

  • Build OSGi services, Sling models, servlets, and Java backend logic within AEM.
  • Develop front-end experiences using HTL, JavaScript, and modern build tools.
  • Implement headless and hybrid delivery patterns using AEM Content Fragments, GraphQL APIs, and edge delivery.
  • Migrate or build implementations on AEM as a Cloud Service with cloud-native CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop AEM Assets workflows including DAM customizations and metadata schema design.
  • Integrate AEM with Adobe Experience Cloud (Target, Analytics, Campaign) and external systems.
  • Implement personalization, A/B testing, and targeted content delivery using AEM and Adobe Target.
  • Optimize page performance, caching, and Dispatcher configuration for high-traffic sites.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Manager, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for AEM deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to standards, and document technical decisions.

Required Qualifications

POSITION SUMMARY

Position Title: Digital Marketing Manager

Department: Integrated Marketing

Reports to: Integrated Marketing Director

About the Organization:The American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN) is the largest specialty nursing organization in the world, representing the interests of more than 550,000 nurses who are charged with caring for acutely and critically ill patients. AACN is dedicated to creating a healthcare system driven by the needs of patients and families where acute and critical care nurses make their optimal contribution.Visit us online at.

AACN is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination against or harassment of any person employed by or seeking employment with AACN on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex and gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions, gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation), ancestry, national origin, age (40 or older), disability (mental and physical), military or veteran status, marital status, medical condition, or genetic information and any other basis protected by federal, state or local law or ordinance or regulation.

Application Instructions:Interested individuals can visit ourCareers Pageand apply for theDigital Marketing Managerrole. Any questions can be directed to:. Theposition is eligible for remote or hybrid on-site work out of our Aliso Viejo, CA national office. Some travel may be required.

Position Purpose:Leads the organization's digital marketing and marketing project management functions by overseeing teams responsible for digital channels, marketing technology, customer experience, and enterprise marketing operations. Develops integrated digital strategies that support organizational priorities, optimize the customer journey, strengthen audience engagement, and ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, prioritized, and delivered.

Main Accountabilities:

  • Translate established digital marketing priorities into plans and initiatives that support audience engagement, optimize the customer journey, and support organizational and business objectives.

    • Lead, coach, and develop the digital marketing team by establishing clear expectations, providing ongoing feedback, managing performance, and fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture.

    • Develop and implement digital marketing plans and initiatives that align with organizational priorities, marketing strategies, business objectives, and leadership direction across email, web, marketing technology, and other digital channels.

    • Oversee website and email marketing plans and execution to ensure digital experiences support audience engagement, business goals, and integrated marketing campaigns.

    • Lead email marketing planning and scheduling, ensuring communications are appropriately prioritized and coordinated across business areas and aligned with organizational messaging, customer needs, and campaign objectives.

    • Evaluate and optimize the end-to-end customer journey across digital channels, identifying opportunities to improve user experience, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall customer satisfaction.

    • Partner with marketing strategists, content strategists, social media, creative services, analytics, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure digital channels support integrated marketing campaigns and cohesive customer experiences.

  • Partner with Marketing leadership to provide leadership for the organization's marketing technology ecosystem while leveraging data, emerging technologies, and digital best practices to improve marketing performance.

    • Collaborate with Marketing leadership, Information Technology, and business leaders to maximize the effectiveness of digital platforms, improve channel capabilities, and identify opportunities for technology enhancements.

    • Lead the ongoing optimization of the organization's marketing technology ecosystem by identifying, evaluating, and implementing tools that improve customer engagement, marketing automation, audience segmentation, analytics, lead generation, and campaign effectiveness for both B2B and B2C audiences.

    • Develop and implement an integrated marketing technology approach that supports customer tracking, audience insights, campaign measurement, personalization, and organizational growth.

    • Use digital marketing analytics, website data, campaign performance, customer insights, and emerging trends to evaluate effectiveness and recommend improvements.

    • Works collaboratively with marketing strategists, the content team, creative services, project management, and other cross-functional teams to develop and execute integrated digital plans and initiatives that support organizational goals and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

    • Ensure digital marketing activities comply with brand standards, accessibility requirements, privacy regulations, and organizational governance.

  • Lead the marketing project management function to improve planning, resource management, collaboration, and execution across enterprise marketing initiatives.

    • Lead the marketing project management team by establishing clear expectations, providing coaching, managing performance, and fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.

    • Lead the marketing project management function, ensuring marketing initiatives are appropriately prioritized, resourced, tracked, and delivered on time while maintaining visibility across established organizational priorities.

    • Oversee marketing project management processes supporting enterprise communications and marketing initiatives, including email communications, eNews, Digital Bold Voices, social media, website updates, marketing campaigns, product launches, and other organizational projects.

    • Fosters a collaborative and inclusive working environment among project management, marketing team members, and business partners across the organization, promoting open communication, shared accountability, and effective cross-functional partnerships.

Skills Required:

  • Demonstrated leadership skills with experience coaching, developing, and managing high-performing digital marketing and marketing project management teams.

  • Expertise developing and executing integrated digital marketing plans and initiatives across email, websites, marketing automation, and other digital channels that support organizational and business objectives.

  • Strong understanding of website strategy, user experience, customer journey mapping, audience engagement, and conversion optimization.

  • Experience leading and optimizing marketing technology platforms, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, marketing automation, digital analytics, and customer data strategies. Experience with Sitecore CMS and Informz email marketing platform preferred.

  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing principles with the ability to align digital plans and channels with enterprise marketing campaigns and business priorities.

  • Demonstrated expertise in marketing project management, including resource planning, prioritization, workflow management, and operational process improvement.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret digital marketing metrics, customer insights, website analytics, and campaign performance to inform decision-making and optimize results.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and partner effectively across leadership, Information Technology, business teams, and cross-functional marketing functions.

  • Strong business judgment, problem-solving, and change management skills with the ability to lead teams through evolving priorities, technologies, and organizational initiatives.

  • Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and staying current on emerging digital marketing technologies, customer behaviors, industry trends, and best practices.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Information Systems, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in digital marketing, marketing technology, marketing operations, or a related field, including management experience with direct accountability for leading and developing marketing, digital, or project management professionals.

  • Experience developing and executing integrated digital marketing plans and initiatives across web, email, marketing automation, and other digital channels.

  • Experience leading marketing technology initiatives and collaborating with Information Technology to implement and optimize digital platforms.

  • Experience managing complex marketing projects, improving operational processes, and using digital analytics and customer insights to drive informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements:

In addition to the responsibilities outlined in the job description, the following requirements represent the essential functions of this job, which must be met by an individual to perform successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. Upon request, the company will engage in an interactive process to identify and implement reasonable accommodations.

This position involves frequent sitting, standing, walking, and reaching, along with regular repetitive hand motions such as typing and mouse use. It requires prolonged periods of desk work and extensive use of standard office equipment. Occasional travel may be necessary.

To perform effectively, the individual must have sufficient visual acuity to read printed materials and digital screens, as well as the auditory ability to comprehend spoken communication. The role demands strong mental stamina to manage multiple tasks, solve problems, determine the appropriate course of action when making decisions, and interpret and apply both oral and written instructions. Regular communication and interaction across various platforms are essential, along with the ability to remain alert, focused, and responsive throughout the workday.

This position also requires proficiency in processing information, communicating across diverse platforms, and analyzing data to inform decision-making. The role involves proactive problem-solving and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to drive organizational objectives, achieve measurable results, and continuous improvement, often with limited direct supervision.

Total Compensation:

The target pay range for this role is $128,160-$142,400

** In addition to the salary range listed, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at AACN even more rewarding. Benefits include generous paid time off, low-cost health plans for medical and mental health services, dental, and vision, company-paid life and short-term disability insurance, a variety of other benefits, and retirement savings program with employer matching and additional company contribution. AACN is committed to a people-centered culture of workplace excellence and belonging, and offers various alternative and flexible work arrangements to support work/life balance for our team members.

Hacksaw Markets is a B2B prediction-market platform that operators can use to offer prediction markets under their own brands. As the Head of Market Resolution you will own the rules, data sources and operating systems used to resolve markets. The role sits at the intersection of product, data, operations, legal and risk: every resolution must be timely, auditable and consistent with the market’s published terms.

What you will own

  • Design the resolution framework, source hierarchy, decision rights, service levels and exception process.
  • Create clear, testable resolution criteria before markets launch, reducing ambiguity and dispute risk.
  • Select and govern authoritative data providers and official sources.
  • Build fallback procedures for delayed, corrected, conflicting or unavailable source data.
  • Automate high-confidence resolutions with product and engineering while preserving human oversight.
  • Lead disputed resolutions and maintain complete evidence and decision trails.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in exchange operations, market data, event settlement, trading operations, data products or comparable systems.
  • Exceptional ability to write precise rules and anticipate edge cases.
  • Experience evaluating data quality, source reliability, dependencies and operational resilience.
  • Comfort working across technical, legal and commercial teams under time pressure.
  • Strong judgment, intellectual honesty and commitment to consistent outcomes.

Why Hacksaw Markets

  • A genuine build-stage mandate with direct influence over product, operating model and culture.
  • An ambitious team supported by established technology, operating experience and long-term capital.
  • The opportunity to help create trusted infrastructure for a category moving rapidly into the mainstream.

Ready to apply?

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant market, system, product or operational challenge you have owned.
