raw.description:
🌟 Ready to help reshape a $26B industry and build the future of branded merch?

commonsku is revolutionizing the promotional products industry. Our platform empowers branded merch distributors to work smarter — managing projects, building quotes, placing orders, and collaborating with clients and suppliers seamlessly through the power of the Connected Workflow.

We’re a remote-first, community-driven team obsessed with elevating our customers, their clients, and the broader industry. Our values – Community First, Ten Steps Ahead, Fast Forward, and Delightful Work – guide us. We believe you can innovate, push forward, and do more, while also sharing a laugh, supporting your colleagues, and having a life outside of work. We’re also proud to be officially recognized as aCertified Great Place to Work® in Canada.

If you’re energized by ambitious work, creative collaboration, and helping to build something great, you’ll want to keep reading.

🚀 About the Role: Marketing Coordinator Coop

We’re growing — and we’re hiring a Marketing Coordinator to join our Marketing team! In this role, you’ll help us drive demand generation, execute paid media strategies, and maintain clear campaign reporting across our marketing channels.

You’ll collaborate closely with teammates across Marketing, Creative, and Sales, contribute to a high-trust environment, and play a direct role in shaping the future of the industry. This role is from January - August 2027.

💡 About You

You’re not just looking for a job — you’re looking for a place to do your best work. You bring:

  • A community mindset — You see customers as partners and coworkers as collaborators. You lift others up, always follow through on your commitments, and thrive in a team that does the same. (Community First)

  • Momentum and ownership — You act with optimism, take initiative, and turn ideas into results. You move fast and bring others with you. (Fast Forward)

  • Vision and boldness — You don’t just react — you anticipate. You think big, challenge the status quo, and push the work (and the industry) forward. (Ten Steps Ahead)

  • Joy in the craft — You care deeply about what you build and how it makes people feel. You bring thoughtfulness, transparency, and a sparkling sense of humour to the table. (Delightful Work)

🛠️ What You’ll Do

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Support the creation, setup, and day-to-day execution of paid media campaigns across LinkedIn, Facebook, Google, and other ad platforms, including audience targeting and testing.

  • Partner with the creative team to develop ad assets and write compelling ad copy.

  • Maintain regular reporting cadences so the team has a clear, up-to-date view of campaign performance.

  • Support email marketing campaigns as part of the broader demand generation mix.

🔍 What You Bring

Some of the qualities that help you thrive in this role:

  • Educational background or equivalent coursework/interest in Commerce, Business Administration, Marketing, Psychology, Communications, or a related field (an interest in paid media and digital marketing matters most).

  • Strong project management, organizational, and written communication skills with high attention to detail when setting up ads and campaigns.

  • An analytical mindset — curious about data, comfortable navigating dashboards, and energized by understanding campaign performance.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort moving quickly in a collaborative team environment.

  • Comfort working independently and asynchronously, while also prioritizing collaboration and connection with people.

  • Experience (or excitement for) working with AI.

  • Bonus: Experience with tools like HubSpot, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or Meta Business Suite, or previous marketing co-op experience.

💰 Compensation & Perks

We believe in fair, transparent compensation. Starting salary for this role is $3,700–$4,150 per month, depending on previous experience and skillset.

New hires are expected to come in at the midpoint of this range. However, if this role sounds perfect for you and your expectations are outside of this range, we encourage you to apply and let us know in your application about your ideal package. If we agree that it’s a good fit, we will have open discussion around what’s possible.

Plus:

  • Remote-first culture (with plenty of excellent in-person experiences sprinkled in)

  • Twice-yearly company wide summits (we call itHQandyou’ll love it)

  • A delightful team of smart people who are good at what they do

🌎 Location

This role is open to candidates eligible to work in Canada (exception of Quebec désolé!).

We’re remote-first, but if you’re based in Toronto, even better. That’s where we were founded and where we maintain our HQ today!

🌱 A Bit More About Us

commonskusupports hundreds of promotional products distributors and suppliers with technology that drive efficiency, growth, and connection. Our skummunity (commonsku + community = skummunity, get it?) is powered byevents,education, andshared knowledgeand is core to who we are.

We’ve grown by being“for promo by promo”and now, we’re scaling our impact to elevating an entire industry. We’d love your help doing it.

🤖 A Note About AI

We use AI every day at commonsku to be faster and better. If you use AI tools to help you draft your resume or cover letter, that’s totally fine — just make sure what you submit reflects you.

In the spirit of transparency, we also use AI to help us work smarter. We utilize Teamtailor’s AI features to assist with applicant screening, note-taking, and interview recording. This technology helps us move quickly and efficiently, but it does not replace our judgment. A member of our Talent team reviews every resume and conducts every interview, ensuring that a human always makes the decision on who advances in our process.

📬 How to Apply

If this role feels like a fit, apply now athttps://commonsku.com/careers!

We try our level best to review and respond to every application we receive. So, once you’ve applied, wait to hear from a member of our People team with an update. If it looks like a good fit, expect a phone interview as the first step.

By the way, you don’t need to meet 100% of the requirements — we value potential, learning, and diversity of thought. Tell us why you're excited, and let’s chat.

❤️ commonsku is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to building a diverse team that reflects the skummunity we serve. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

Are you a self-motivated "hunter" who thrives on variety? Guide Book Publishing, an industry leader since 1991, is looking for a strategic Advertising Account Executive. Unlike traditional sales roles where you call the same list for years, our team moves to a new assignment every 2-3 weeks, helping local businesses across 24 states reach "micro-communities" through high-quality direct-mail advertising.

How it Works

  • The Workflow: You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.
  • The Method: 70% of your time is spent on high-energy outreach (phone, email, and video meetings); 20% on market research; and 10% on contract execution.
  • The Flexibility: This is a remote role, but does require getting your materials back to the Post Office to return to the Home Office.

Key Responsibilities

  • New Business Development: Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.
  • Consultative Sales: Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.
  • Relationship Management: Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.
  • Account Growth: Nurture and maintain large-scale accounts within your metro area.
  • Administrative Precision: Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

  • Draw & Commission: Payroll is based on "Cash In" from sales, with a Draw program available to stabilize income as you build your funnel.
  • Performance Bonuses: Additional incentive pay for hitting Assignment, Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual targets.
  • Benefits:
    • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Life Insurance
    • Paid Time Off (PTO)

Qualifications

  • Experience: 1-2 years of sales experience preferred (or equivalent education).
  • Mindset: A self-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.
  • Skills: Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.
  • Communication: Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.
  • Requirements: Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance.

Why Guide Book Publishing?

We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast-paced nature of community-based sales, we want to talk to you.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Requires Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance
  • Frequently required to sit and utilize a keyboard and phone.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses, such as credit, overdrafts, etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SRE to engineer the reliability of our highly distributed platform. You will combine deep knowledge of distributed systems with strong coding skills to define SLOs, lead incident response, and build automation and self-healing mechanisms into our systems. You will balance immediate operational stability with long-term strategic engineering to ensure our services scale linearly with our hyper-growth.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in on-call rotations. Act as the Incident Commander during major severity incidents: initiating war rooms, coordinating cross-functional teams, and providing clear status updates.
  • Instrument code to expose high-cardinality metrics and distributed traces. Collaboratively define, measure, and defend Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets with product owners.
  • Write high-quality, production-ready code (in Java, Go, or Python) to build internal tooling, automation platforms, and self-healing mechanisms that eliminate manual operator intervention.
  • Partner with Product Engineering teams during the design phase to ensure new services are built with reliability, scalability, and observability patterns (circuit breakers, rate limiting, backpressure, fallback strategies) from day one.
  • Analyze system performance and traffic patterns to model future capacity needs. Conduct load testing and chaos engineering experiments to verify system resilience under failure conditions.
    .

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE or Backend Engineering with a strong ability to write clean, performant, and tested code in Java, Go, Rust, or Python.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and design patterns. You possess a strong command of microservices fundamentals, event-driven architectures, and the underlying principles required to build systems that scale.
  • Extensive experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud providers (AWS/Azure). You are proficient in running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and troubleshooting cluster/infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing observability strategies using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, New Relic, Datadog, or SigNoz to improve system visibility.
  • Familiarity with operating and tuning production data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) in a high-throughput environment.

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A technical interview with the Hiring Manager
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Johns Manville is a leading manufacturer and marketer of premium-quality insulation and commercial roofing, along with glass fibers and nonwovens for commercial, industrial and residential applications. Our products are used in a wide variety of industries including building products, aerospace, automotive and transportation, filtration, commercial interiors, waterproofing and wind energy.

A proud member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies, we serve customers in more than 80 countries around the globe. We are committed to delivering positive and powerful experiences, because we are successful only when our employees and customers thrive. We are passionate, we care about people, we perform at a superior level, and we protect others and our environments.

Pay Range

$109,300.00-$150,300.00 Annual

This is the base salary pay range that an applicant can expect to make upon hire. Pay within this range will vary based upon relevant experience, skills, and education among other factors. In addition, this position is eligible for an incentive bonus.

The Sr. Sales Representative for Johns Manville’s Commercial Roofing business is responsible for driving measurable revenue growth, expanding market presence, and building long‑term customer partnerships across the Raleigh territory. This role focuses on creating demand for Johns Manville roofing products and systems, increasing product adoption, and generating sustainable, profitable sales results.


Deliver Territory Revenue & Growth Targets

  • Achieve annual sales quotas and margin goals across assigned commercial roofing product lines.
  • Expand territory revenue by developing and executing a targeted geographic and account‑level growth plan.
  • Accelerate product penetration by identifying high‑value opportunities with contractors, distributors, architects, and building owners.

Build & Sustain High‑Impact Customer Relationships

  • Strengthen partnerships with key contractors and distributors to increase product adoption and repeat business.
  • Consistently generate new accounts while maximizing share of wallet within existing customers.
  • Maintain a regular cadence of customer visits, business reviews, and project pipeline assessments.

Create Market Demand & Competitive Positioning

  • Conduct ongoing market intelligence to anticipate customer needs, assess competitor activity, and identify strategic opportunities.
  • Recommend and execute market‑specific programs to expand product visibility, accelerate adoption, and drive differentiation.
  • Influence specifications by presenting system solutions to architects and decision‑makers.

Drive Sales Excellence & Execution

  • Produce accurate forecasts, pipeline reports, and territory performance summaries.
  • Prepare competitive bids, negotiate pricing within established guidelines, and secure profitable contracts.
  • Support product development by communicating customer feedback and emerging market needs.

Enhance Customer Capability & Product Expertise

  • Deliver product demonstrations, technical training, and value‑focused presentations to customers and channel partners.
  • Provide on‑site technical assistance and problem resolution to ensure customer satisfaction and system performance.
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert on Johns Manville roofing systems.

Uphold Operational & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure all product sales, documentation, and field activities comply with local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, opportunities, and sales activity.

Contribute to Team Success

  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with marketing, technical services, and product management to drive territory success.

Requirements & Success Profile


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of professional experience in a similar role.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in building products, construction materials, or related field.
  • Valid driver’s license; residence within the Raleigh metro area; ability to travel.

Skills & Performance Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a competitive market.
  • Strong capability to introduce and scale new products or systems.
  • Experience influencing third‑party channels, including distributors, contractors, and design professionals.
  • Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, territory expenses, and profitability targets.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship‑building skills.
  • Proven ability to manage complex contracts and multi‑stakeholder decision processes.
  • Strong problem‑solving, organizational, and time‑management skills.

*Note, willing to consider someone with a Bachelor's degree and 5 yrs of sales experience and/or JM relevant experience or equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered but they would be coming in at a Sales Representative level and salary range would be 95-110k/ year.


#P #D

Please Keep in Mind

If you do not meet 100% of these requirements, we at JM still want to hear from you. So, if you are interested in the role, we encourage you to apply so we can learn how your skills and talents can contribute to our team.

Benefits

Johns Manville (JM) offers a wide range of benefits to employees. Some are subsidized by the company and others are fully employee-paid. Health benefits include a choice of comprehensive medical plans, a dental plan, vision plan, wellness program and critical illness insurance. JM sponsors a 401(k) plan which includes a sizeable company match. JM offers paid vacation and also provides paid sick and parental leave for eligible employees.

Johns Manville supports employee growth with vast educational opportunities and a company-wide mentoring program. This program pairs employees and leaders to grow skills, build stronger internal networks and strengthen the company’s succession planning process. Johns Manville also offers soft and hard skills training facilitated by internal and external presenters. Our talent management team prioritizes the holistic growth of our workforce.

Diversity & Inclusion

Johns Manville believes diversity and inclusion in our workplace is critical for the long-term success of our company. We are committed to retaining, developing and attracting a diverse workforce that fosters an inclusive work environment in which all employees are treated with dignity and respect. This is the right thing to do for our employees, our company and our communities.

raw.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Empower is transforming how Americans experience wealth, bridging workplace retirement and personal wealth products and services to deliver more holistic, accessible financial solutions. We are seeking a seasoned attorney to join our legal team as a strategic partner to our Personal Wealth product organization.

This role has primary accountability for supporting the development and delivery of personal wealth products. You will partner across retirement, wealth, compliance, and business teams where those areas intersect. Few organizations operate at this scale across both retirement and personal wealth, creating a unique opportunity to design integrated solutions for millions of customers.

You will help design and launch next-generation wealth solutions that reach millions of customers. If you are energized by building, not just reviewing, and want to help shape the future of retail wealth, this role offers a unique platform to do so.

What you will do:

  • Serve as lead counsel to the Personal Wealth product organization, advising on the design, development, implementation and distribution of innovative wealth offerings
  • Partner closely with product, compliance, risk and business leaders from concept through launch, ensuring aligned, practical solutions across legal, risk and compliance while enabling speed to market
  • Coordinate across Empower’s broader legal team to deliver aligned, consistent, and business-oriented guidance, ensuring a “one voice” approach to legal advice
  • Navigate complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including the Investment Advisers Act, the Exchange Act, SEC and FINRA rules, ERISA/DOL fiduciary standards, and state laws and regulations
  • Advise on product structures and distribution across direct-to-consumer and advisor-led channels
  • Provide guidance on SEC and ERISA fiduciary obligations as applicable, Reg BI, conflicts of interest management, and client disclosures
  • Advise on and help shape Empower’s approach to the responsible use of artificial intelligence and data-driven technologies in wealth products, including evolving state and federal guidance and rulemaking related to predictive analytics, conflicts of interest, model governance, and client communications
  • Support product governance, regulatory filings and client-facing materials
  • Advise on third-party partnerships and evolving fintech capabilities
  • Monitor regulatory and industry developments, translating them into practical guidance for product, compliance, and other legal stakeholders

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Direct impact: Shape products that support millions of retirement plan participants and personal wealth clients as their financial needs evolve
  • Builder mindset: Work closely with the product organization to shape strategy and enable execution
  • Innovation with purpose: Help expand access to sophisticated wealth solutions
  • Enterprise impact: Shape products and solutions that serve millions of investors across their financial lifecycle
  • Strategic seat at the table: Partner directly with senior product and business leaders to shape product direction, not just advising on execution
  • Innovation in a regulated environment: Help navigate and define approaches in emerging areas like AI, digital advice, and retail access to new products and services

What You Bring

  • J.D. and active bar membership
  • 15+ years of experience advising retail wealth management businesses (RIA, broker-dealer, or hybrid)
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management legal and regulatory frameworks including deep familiarity with SEC, FINRA, and state regulatory regimes particularly related to duties of care, disclosure, and conflicts of interest
  • Exposure to emerging wealth products including direct indexing, alternatives, retirement income strategies
  • Experience supporting product strategy, development and launch, ideally in a fast-paced or technology-enabled environment
  • Sound judgment and ability to balance legal and regulatory risk with business objectives
  • Comfort operating in evolving or ambiguous regulatory environments
  • Operates as a senior individual contributor with strong cross-functional influence
  • Executive presence and ability to communicate practical legal guidance clearly to senior business, product and other legal stakeholders

Preferred Experience

  • Experience at integrated retirement/wealth service providers, asset managers, RIAs, broker-dealers, fintech platforms, or other scaled financial services firms
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management legal frameworks, with familiarity or experience in retirement/ERISA frameworks strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with digital platforms, data-driven personalization, or fintech partnerships
  • Experience advising on distribution across retirement, direct-to-consumer, and advisor-led channels
  • Experience with product governance committees, disclosure/conflicts governance, and regulatory examinations
  • Familiarity with emerging retail products such as cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and prediction markets

How We Work at Empower

At Empower, how we work matters as much as what we build. We value collaboration, transparency, and shared ownership, and our legal team is viewed as a critical enabler of innovation—not a barrier.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Operates with a “one team” mindset, building strong, trust-based relationships across functions
  • Communicates clearly and pragmatically, translating complex legal concepts into actionable guidance
  • Takes accountability, exercises sound judgment, and leads with integrity
  • Embraces Empower’s values and contributes to a culture where diverse perspectives and ideas drive better outcomes
  • Proactively aligns with legal, compliance, and risk partners to ensure consistent, enterprise-wide positions, avoiding siloed or fragmented advice

Why Empower

Empower is uniquely positioned at the convergence of retirement and wealth. This creates an opportunity to build differentiated products and to do so in a way that meaningfully improves financial outcomes for millions of people. This role offers the opportunity to help define how retirement and wealth solutions converge, an area of increasing focus across the industry, but one where Empower is uniquely positioned to lead.

If you’re looking for a role where you can influence strategy, build innovative solutions, and be part of a collaborative, mission-driven culture, we’d like to meet you.


***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$183,600.00 - $266,250.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. raw.description:
Primary Mission:

The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises. The position assists the Lane Support SME in coordinating logistics, manpower, resources, exercise infrastructure, and administrative requirements across assigned areas of operation.

The Assistant Lane Support SME must demonstrate strong organizational, logistical, asset deconfliction, and project management capabilities while supporting multiple exercises in various stages of development and execution. The position requires effective coordination with military personnel, Government agencies, civilian authorities, and domestic and international exercise participants in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Provide operational, logistical, and administrative support to the WVNG Joint Staff Office, WVNG J37, WVNG J3 Joint Operations Center, and Ridge Runner Program in support of exercise planning, coordination, and execution.
  • Assist the Lane Support SME with planning, development, coordination, and execution of Ridge Runner training activities, including Concept Development Conferences (CDC), Initial Planning Conferences (IPC), Mid Planning Conferences (MPC), Final Planning Conferences (FPC), and post-exercise closeout activities.
  • Coordinate with domestic and foreign exercise participants, military organizations, Government agencies, and external stakeholders to synchronize exercise requirements, resources, schedules, and operational support.
  • Support exercise lane development, site preparation, setup, execution, and recovery, including coordination with local business owners, municipal officials, and private landowners for access to facilities, infrastructure, and training locations through the Realistic Military Training (RMT) Packet process.
  • Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, and emergency medical services to support exercise integration, public safety, and operational requirements.
  • Prepare and coordinate exercise notifications and required Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Letters of Understanding (LOUs) with applicable jurisdictions, organizations, and property owners.
  • Assist the Lane Support SME with exercise lane management, safety coordination, logistical support, personnel accountability, and resolution of operational or administrative issues during exercise execution.
  • Support the coordination and delivery of Irregular Warfare training activities, instructional preparation, and exercise-related briefings in accordance with established Ridge Runner training objectives and program requirements.
  • Perform administrative functions including event scheduling, calendar management, email and telephone correspondence, meeting coordination, note-taking, records maintenance, document organization, and tracking of assigned actions.
  • Assist with coordination of foreign participant requirements, including foreign visit requests, installation access procedures, and communication with appropriate Government representatives when required.
  • Maintain effective communication with Ridge Runner leadership, the Lane Support SME, exercise controllers, and participating organizations to identify emerging requirements, resolve coordination issues, and ensure continuity of exercise support.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Required Qualifications and Education

  • Special Operations Experience: Minimum five (5) years of operational experience as an operator within a U.S. Special Operations organization, including USASOC, MARSOC, or NSWDG, with at least three (3) years of administrative or operational support to senior leaders in high-tempo or mission-driven environments.
  • Operational or Executive Support Experience: At least three (3) years providing administrative or operational support to senior leaders in military, law enforcement, executive, or other mission-driven environments will be considered.
  • Organizational and Logistical Management: Demonstrated ability to manage calendars, coordinate travel, track personnel and resources, deconflict logistical requirements, and support complex schedules with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Discretion and Security Awareness: Experience handling sensitive or confidential information with a strong understanding of operational security (OPSEC), information protection, and applicable security procedures.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and organizational levels, including military leadership, Government agencies, civilian stakeholders, and international participants.
  • Problem-Solving and Adaptability: Proven ability to anticipate requirements, resolve issues proactively, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing operational conditions in high-pressure environments.
  • Education: High school graduate.

Preferred Qualifications and Education

  • Graduate of the U.S. Army Special Forces Qualification Course or a comparable advanced Special Operations qualification course from another U.S. SOF component, including SEAL Qualification Training or the MARSOC Individual Training Course.
  • Five (5) years of documented experience as a primary instructor or course manager at a U.S. Special Operations schoolhouse.
  • Experience supporting joint, interagency, or multinational military training exercises, including exercise planning, logistics coordination, and operational execution.
  • Familiarity with Irregular Warfare training environments, Realistic Military Training (RMT) coordination procedures, and military exercise planning processes.

Work Authorization / Security Clearance requirements

  • Must possess a Secret security clearance or be eligible to obtain and maintain one in accordance with Government and contractual requirements.
  • Must comply with applicable installation access requirements, operational security procedures, and information protection standards.
  • Must be available to participate in pre-exercise planning conferences, coordination meetings, exercise execution, and post-exercise activities as required.
  • Must be capable of performing duties in office and field environments, including varying weather conditions and terrain.

Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Must maintain the physical readiness necessary to perform assigned duties in a Special Operations training environment, including field movement, exercise setup, and operational support under varying environmental conditions.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.

The Director, Enterprise Quality Methodologies, Governance & Enablement will lead the definition, governance, and enterprise adoption of quality engineering standards, methodologies, compliance alignment, quality intelligence, AI-enabled engineering practices, and transformation enablement. This leader will establish “what good looks like” for Quality Engineering across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem and ensure quality practices are consistently embedded across the SDLC, Agile ways of working, engineering platforms, DevOps governance routines, and responsible use of AI-enabled capabilities.

This role will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile Office, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Data and AI teams, and segment technology teams to mature enterprise quality practices, strengthen governance frameworks, enable platform adoption, and improve quality outcomes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Strategy, Policy, and Standards

  • Define and evolve the enterprise Quality Engineering strategy, standards, methodologies, and operating procedures across software delivery teams.
  • Establish SDLC quality standards, policies, and practical guidance that embed quality earlier and more consistently across planning, development, testing, release, and production validation.
  • Create and maintain enterprise engineering best practices, including “What Good Looks Like” guidance for quality planning, test automation, code quality, regression testing, deployment validation, performance testing, release readiness, production quality, and AI-assisted quality engineering practices.
  • Align Quality Engineering ways of working with Agile Office practices, DevOps governance, platform standards, enterprise delivery models, and responsible AI expectations.
  • Partner with engineering enablement teams to ensure quality standards are reflected in enterprise tooling, pipelines, templates, reusable workflows, development practices, and AI-enabled engineering workflows where appropriate.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering and Transformation

  • Lead the integration of AI-enabled quality engineering practices into enterprise methodologies, governance models, coaching programs, and SDLC quality standards.
  • Define guidance for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test design, test generation, defect analysis, requirements analysis, code review support, test data analysis, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and productivity improvement.
  • Partner with Data, AI, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering stakeholders to ensure AI-enabled quality practices align with enterprise policies, risk controls, privacy requirements, and responsible AI principles.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use generative AI, machine learning, analytics, and intelligent automation to improve quality planning, coverage analysis, risk-based testing, defect prevention, release readiness, and production quality insights.
  • Establish governance and measurement practices for AI-enabled quality capabilities, including adoption, value realization, risk management, human oversight, and continuous improvement.

Governance, Compliance, and Quality Maturity

  • Establish and maintain enterprise Quality Engineering governance frameworks that improve consistency, transparency, risk management, compliance alignment, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Define, implement, and mature a Quality Engineering maturity model that helps teams assess capability, prioritize improvement opportunities, and measure progress over time.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, AI governance, and technology stakeholders to align quality engineering practices with enterprise controls, regulatory expectations, internal policies, and emerging AI governance standards.
  • Develop governance routines, decision forums, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor adoption of quality standards and identify systemic risks.
  • Use governance insights to drive continuous improvement across SDLC quality practices, DevOps controls, AI-enabled engineering practices, release quality, automation adoption, and production readiness.

Education, Enablement, and Transformation Support

  • Lead organizational enablement programs that help teams adopt enterprise Quality Engineering standards, methodologies, tools, AI-enabled capabilities, and ways of working.
  • Oversee Quality Engineering coaches who guide teams through quality planning, maturity assessments, platform onboarding, automation adoption, AI-assisted quality practices, and SDLC quality improvement.
  • Partner with platform and engineering enablement teams to support onboarding and integration across enterprise engineering platforms, including Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, LaunchDarkly, SonarQube, and related quality tools.
  • Lead QE Community of Practice forums, learning initiatives, training programs, enablement content, and knowledge-sharing routines that strengthen enterprise quality capability and AI fluency.
  • Support enterprise quality transformation initiatives by translating strategy into practical adoption models, playbooks, coaching plans, metrics, and change management approaches.

Quality Intelligence and Analytics

  • Define and advance enterprise quality intelligence capabilities that provide actionable insight into engineering quality, SDLC compliance, quality maturity, release readiness, AI adoption, and production quality trends.
  • Partner with data, platform, DevOps, AI, and engineering teams to develop dashboards and scorecards for quality standards adoption, automation coverage, code quality, deployment validation, performance testing, defect trends, governance compliance, and AI-enabled quality outcomes.
  • Leverage quality and engineering metrics, including DevOps, DORA, pipeline, code quality, pull request, build, deployment, AI productivity, and compliance indicators, to guide improvement efforts.
  • Translate quality data into executive insights, risk themes, maturity trends, and recommendations that improve technology delivery outcomes.

QE Audit and Control Support

  • Lead Quality Engineering coordination for internal and external audits, including audit planning, evidence collection, control alignment, response coordination, and remediation tracking.
  • Partner with Audit, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, AI governance, Engineering, and platform teams to ensure Quality Engineering standards and evidence are aligned to applicable controls.
  • Establish repeatable audit support processes, evidence repositories, ownership models, and reporting routines to improve audit readiness and reduce operational friction.
  • Identify audit findings, control gaps, AI-related control considerations, and recurring evidence challenges; partner with stakeholders to drive corrective actions and sustainable improvements.

Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team focused on quality methodology, governance, enablement, coaching, analytics, AI-enabled quality practices, and audit support.
  • Influence leaders and teams across a matrixed enterprise environment to adopt consistent quality standards, measurable engineering practices, and responsible AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, learning, responsible innovation, and customer-centered quality.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders on enterprise Quality Engineering maturity, AI-enabled transformation, risk, compliance, standards adoption, and transformation progress.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in quality engineering, software engineering, DevOps, technology governance, IT risk, compliance, technology enablement, AI-enabled engineering transformation, or related disciplines.
  • 5 or more years of leadership experience managing technical teams, enablement teams, governance functions, or enterprise-scale transformation capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing software quality standards, methodologies, operating procedures, or SDLC governance practices.
  • Experience applying or governing AI-enabled capabilities in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, analytics, productivity improvement, or technology transformation.
  • Experience with Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, software engineering controls, release readiness, and production quality practices.
  • Experience developing maturity models, governance frameworks, scorecards, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience partnering with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, Engineering, Product, AI/Data, and technology leadership stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of quality engineering practices, including test automation, regression testing, deployment validation, code quality, performance testing, defect prevention, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence enterprise adoption of standards and best practices in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong executive communication, analytical, organizational, and change leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience leading Quality Engineering enablement, Agile transformation, DevOps governance, engineering excellence, AI-enabled engineering transformation, or enterprise platform adoption.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, LaunchDarkly, SonarQube, CI/CD templates, reusable workflows, feature flags, code quality tooling, DevOps governance practices, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Experience with audit evidence management, control mapping, SDLC compliance, segregation of duties, access controls, vulnerability scanning, software delivery governance, and AI governance considerations.
  • Experience applying DORA, SPACE, code quality, pipeline, release, AI productivity, quality intelligence, and compliance metrics to improve engineering performance.
  • Experience building Communities of Practice, coaching models, training programs, learning journeys, AI literacy programs, or enterprise enablement frameworks.

raw.title: Senior Node.js Developer (Belarus)
raw.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

raw.description:
From screening to research and development, Lunit is transforming how the world advances cancer detection — boldly, intelligently, and with humanity at the core.

We build trusted partnerships with clinicians, health systems, and companies worldwide to deliver validated AI solutions that enhance clinical confidence, accelerate discovery, prioritize precision care — and bring the future of cancer diagnostics within reach.

To find out how you could contribute to our mission to conquer cancer as a Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager please read on.

Purpose:

The Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager will own the development and execution of scalable education and engagement programs that enable customers to confidently adopt, optimize, and expand their use of Lunit breast software across USCAN, LATAM, and EU. This role translates customer needs, product capabilities, and clinical workflow requirements into high-impact learning experiences for radiologists, technologists, and clinical and operational teams. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Onboarding/Implementation, the Customer Education & Engagement Lead will build programs that support successful onboarding, on-time go-lives, sustained utilization, and long-term customer advocacy.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the regional execution of customer education and engagement programs that drive adoption, proficiency, workflow optimization, and long-term utilization of Lunit breast software.
  • Design and maintain scalable learning pathways
    for customer onboarding, go-live readiness, release-based training, advanced workflow optimization, and ongoing product enablement.
  • Partner with Customer Onboarding/Implementation to embed training milestones, completion tracking, and readiness criteria into customer project plans to support successful deployments and revenue recognition timelines.
  • Develop a comprehensive education calendar that includes live training, virtual sessions, on-demand modules, webinars, masterclasses, user group discussions, and customer community events.
  • Create and maintain high-quality training materials, including e-learning modules, workflow simulations, video tutorials, quick-reference guides, facilitator materials, and customer-facing educational resources.
  • Ensure education content remains aligned with product updates, the Lunit roadmap, regulatory requirements, and evolving breast imaging workflows and clinical guidelines.
  • Partner with Marketing to launch customer education and thought-leadership programs that strengthen Lunit’s market presence, showcase customer expertise, and reinforce Lunit as a premium and innovative partner.
  • Manage and optimize the Absorb LMS customer training experience, including enrollment paths, certification tracking, reporting, learner engagement, and consumption analytics.
  • Leverage Higher Logic Vanilla to support digital community engagement, peer-to-peer learning, customer feedback loops, exclusive educational events, and champion cultivation.
  • Build strong relationships with customer champions, clinical stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to ensure education programs reflect real-world customer needs and measurable business outcomes.
  • Define, monitor, and report on education and engagement KPIs, including training completion, learner satisfaction, time-to-value, adoption indicators, community engagement, certification progress, and training impact.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Affairs and Marketing to lead the strategy, development, and execution of accredited CME and CEU programs (via ASRT, AHRA, or ACCME) to drive market thought-leadership, lead generation, and user engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to use education as a customer success and commercial enablement tool, helping reduce churn risk, increase utilization, support renewals, and uncover expansion opportunities.

What you will bring to the role:

  • 5+ years managing customer education, clinical training, or customer success enablement within MedTech, Medical Imaging, AI clinical tools, or SaaS.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Sciences, Instructional Design, Business, or a related field (Master's or valid clinical credentials like ARRT (R)(M) or ASMIRT preferred).
  • Deep understanding of breast imaging modalities, radiology operations, and clinical workflows (PACS/RIS) for radiologists and technologists.
  • Active engagement or a robust network within leading societies across USCAN, EU, and LATAM (SBI, ACR, ASRT, EUSOBI, ESR, EFRS, SIBIM, RANZCR, or ASMIRT).
  • Proven ability to leverage society relationships to track clinical trends, source subject matter experts (SMEs), and co-develop educational programming.
  • Demonstrated success designing scalable learning pathways, certifications, and blended curricula (live, virtual, on-demand) using adult learning principles.
  • Hands-on experience with Learning Management Systems (ideally Absorb LMS), community platforms (Higher Logic Vanilla), and content tools (Articulate Storyline/Rise).
  • Exceptional ability to collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to translate technical software updates into clinical learning content.
  • Strong operational discipline to manage multiple education initiatives, customer deadlines, and localized assets across regions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the presence and empathy required to train and influence radiologists, techs, and hospital executives.
  • Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or key European languages is highly advantageous for regional adoption.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30–40% across USCAN, LATAM, and EU for customer go-lives, site visits, and industry events.

What you will receive:

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per annum, full time equivalent. Benefits include the option to participate in medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances; a 401K plan with a company match; and generous paid time off.

Other things to note:

  • This role will be hybrid if the successful applicant lives within commuting distance of our US office (Lynnwood, WA). For candidates outside this location, the role will be fully remote.
  • Candidates must currently have the right to work in the United States to apply.
  • Lunit International operates across multiple time zones, and this role may occasionally require working outside of standard business hours to support international customers or team collaboration. We offer flexible scheduling to help balance these needs with personal commitments/work life balance.

Lunit International is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We will endeavor to fill vacancies with the candidate who is the best fit for the role, without regard to gender, marital or family status, religious or ethical belief, race, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, political opinion, employment status, military status, sexual orientation or any other status protected by law.

  • Experience conducting outbound phone calls to US-based suppliers, vendors, or business contacts in a professional capacity

Nice-to-Have

If you’re passionate about recruiting, enjoy building talent pipelines, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment, this role is built for you.

Candidate Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Management

    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Job boards
    • Networking

Building an AI‑first organization is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve.   • Ability to work independently and effectively manage projects and priorities from start to finish

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Able to develop and improve workflow processes and procedures, and drive client process improvements

Job Title: Director - LIMS Strategy - CPG & F&B

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems has built the first modern cloud LIMS system, and we are hiring a Director of LIMS Strategy, QualityOne, to accelerate our growth across global accounts in the Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), and Chemical Ingredients industries.
In this high-impact role, you will architect and execute the commercial strategy for our LIMS product line within these target sectors. You will act as the ultimate bridge between sales, marketing, product, and services, unifying them into a cohesive market vision while developing and personally delivering key messaging, training sales teams, and establishing industry thought leadership.
We are seeking a visionary leader with deep expertise in laboratory informatics, strong market intuition, and relevant experience in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) supply chain who can seamlessly pivot from high-level strategy to hands-on, day-to-day execution.

What You'll Do

Market Expansion & Growth

    • Drive Market Entry: Own the growth and market penetration of Veeva LIMS for QualityOne across target FMCG and their supply chain sectors
    • Act as a Commercial Leader: Operate in a high-visibility, customer-facing commercial capacity to drive positive outcomes for both customers and Veeva
    • Champion Thought Leadership: Serve as an industry evangelist by presenting at major conferences, leading webinars, and authoring content for industry publications

Customer Engagement & Deal Strategy

    • Discovery & Workshops: Lead customer discovery sessions to uncover pain points, define desired benefits, and co-create solutions powered by Veeva LIMS
    • Deliver High-Impact Presentations: Support sales in creating and delivering compelling presentations to prospects, active customers, and executive stakeholders
    • Support Deals: Help prospective customers build their business cases to justify investments and accelerate the sales cycle. Support sales in deal strategy, pricing and proposals
    • Analyze the Competition: Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and develop tactical strategies and materials to win against competitors

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

    • Influence Product Roadmap: Provide vital business and technology guidance to the product team to shape new or enhanced features in laboratory informatics software
    • Enable Field Teams: Provide strategic direction and messaging to field-facing teams while building strong relationships with executive leadership
    • Coordinate the Customer Lifecycle: Align and coordinate resources across the entire customer journey, from initial sales to final delivery and beyond
    • Build Communities: Engage deeply with communities of practice and manage relationships with both internal and external stakeholders and partners

Requirements

Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge

    • Informatics Background: 8+ years of experience growing and scaling a technology offering at a laboratory informatics software vendor and/or a laboratory informatics consulting firm
    • Industry Alignment: Proven track record working with Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), supply chain companies, or closely related industries
    • Executive Presence: Proven ability to hold meaningful, strategic conversations with Heads of Quality, QC, and IT leaders regarding software applications and modernization
    • Innovation & Problem Solving: Demonstrated success innovating across complex business processes and technical solutions using critical thinking

Communication & Influence

    • Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
    • High-Impact Presenter: Dynamic presentation skills with the ability to be clear, concise, convincing, confident, and credible to any audience
    • Relationship Builder: Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for collaborating and working closely with people

Drive & Execution

    • Self-Starter Mentality: Driven and highly motivated leader who is comfortable taking initiative and working independently
    • Execution Excellence: Detail-oriented with a strong, self-imposed standard of quality, diligence, and a hard-working "want to win" attitude
    • Travel Flexibility: Ability and willingness to travel up to 40% for customer meetings and presentations

Nice to Have

    • Quality & Manufacturing Domain Expertise: Industry experience spanning Quality Control (QC), GxP quality content, training management, quality systems processes, or manufacturing
    • Commercial Leadership: Proven experience leading or guiding global sales teams to aggressively pursue and close complex enterprise opportunities
    • Executive Relationship Management: Seasoned background in establishing, expanding, and maintaining trusted partnerships with C-suite and executive-level stakeholders
    • Established Authority: Published thought leadership pieces, whitepapers, or articles within the laboratory informatics domain

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 120,000 - 200,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

raw.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

As Chief Information Officer (CIO), you’ll lead the technology our teams rely on every day. That includes the systems employees use, the enterprise applications that run our go-to-market and financial operations, our data platform, our corporate website, and our cloud infrastructure.

You’ll lead through strong domain owners, and you’ll stay close enough to the technology to set standards, weigh plans, and ask the hard questions. You’ll work alongside our product general managers, product AI organization, security team, and Finance.

What you’ll do

Set direction and own the enterprise systems estate

  • Set priorities for internal technology against company plans, and hold each domain accountable for delivery.
  • Own our enterprise applications, from CRM and marketing automation through ERP and financials, including the quote-to-cash flow between them.
  • Guide enterprise and data architecture, and lead the integration and data engineers who build it.
  • Run one intake, change-control, and planning cadence so a change in one system doesn’t break another.

Lead operations, data, and IT

  • Lead Enterprise Systems and Revenue Operations, aligning systems ownership with operating responsibility for the go-to-market stack.
  • Lead Cloud Operations across corporate and production environments (AWS and Azure), including availability, performance, cost, and security posture.
  • Lead IT and end-user services: service desk, endpoints, identity and access, Microsoft 365, and Workday administration.
  • Own our Snowflake data platform and integrations, with access governance set jointly with Finance.
  • Own the corporate website, including development, vendor relationships, and change control.

Manage risk, spend, and AI

  • Partner with our security team: you’re accountable for posture and execution, and they set standards and audit.
  • Govern internal process automation and AI agents, including approval gates and production-readiness review, in coordination with the product AI organization.
  • Own the technology budget and major vendor relationships, including planning, negotiation, and ROI.
  • Build and retain a high-performing team with a clear owner for every domain.

What you bring

Required

  • 15+ years in technology leadership, with growing responsibility for teams, programs, and budgets.
  • 8+ years directing technical leaders across multiple disciplines.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise and ERP architecture, data modeling, integration, and data engineering.
  • Experience across enterprise applications and cloud infrastructure, leading through domain owners.
  • Experience leading large-scale technology transformation and consolidation.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and SOC 2 in a regulated, data-sensitive environment.
  • A technical foundation, ideally including early-career engineering experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • SaaS or healthcare experience.
  • Hands-on credibility with modern data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Contract negotiation experience that protects scope and delivers value.


How you work

  • You explain technology in business terms. You build trust with product, finance, legal, and executive partners.
  • You decide, then hold people accountable. You set direction and empower owners to deliver.
  • You respect the budget. You bring the ROI discipline a finance team expects.

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria.

The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

AtEnsora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. ​

​We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.
