raw.excerpt: Summary Workiva is looking for a Sr.  Director of Tax to shape and execute our global tax strategy.
raw.description:
Summary


Workiva is looking for a Sr. Director of Tax to shape and execute our global tax strategy. In this leadership role, you will lead our tax function while driving compliance, risk management, and strategic planning across all global operations. You will partner closely with executive leaders to support long-term business goals and ensure seamless financial execution. If you are a visionary tax leader ready to drive impact in a fast-paced technology environment, we want to hear from you.


What You'll Do


  • Develop and execute the company's long-term global corporate income tax and indirect tax strategies, aligned with business growth, to manage the effective tax rate, cash taxes, and tax risk.
  • Own the quarterly and annual global tax provision under ASC 740, including current and deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, and effective tax rate analysis. Be responsible for all tax-related SEC disclosures (10-K, 10-Q, proxy), including the income tax footnote, rate reconciliation, and MD&A discussion.
  • Evaluate and apply new accounting and tax guidance, and document technical positions in memos.
  • Partner with Controllership, Legal, Investor Relations, and external auditors on disclosures, audits, and SOX controls over income taxes.
  • Oversee U.S. federal, state and local, and non-U.S. income tax compliance, and ensure timely, accurate filings globally.
  • Own U.S. international tax positions and planning, including GILTI (NCTI), Subpart F, FDII (FDDEI), BEAT and foreign tax credits.
  • Monitor Pillar Two and global minimum tax developments and readiness.
  • Own transfer-pricing policy and manage tax exposure across intercompany arrangements; partner with Controller on intercompany accounting, documentation and elimination.
  • Direct withholding, treaty and permanent establishment analysis on cross-border flows.
  • Identify and execute tax planning opportunities, including credits, incentives, and entity structuring. Evaluate complex tax legislation changes to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
  • Provide tax diligence, structuring, and integration support for M&A and financing transactions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of four tax professionals, reviewing their provision, compliance, and technical work for accuracy and quality.
  • Advise executive leadership on tax risk and the tax implications of business initiatives.

What You'll Need


Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license or Juris Doctor (JD) degree.
  • 15+ years of progressive tax experience, including public accounting and in-house roles at a U.S. public multinational with at least five years of direct people management experience.
  • Deep expertise in ASC 740 and SEC tax reporting, including drafting disclosures and working with external auditors.
  • Proven ability to develop long-term tax strategy and to review and coach staff, ideally as a player-coach who stays close to technical work.
  • Ability to multi-task, establish priorities, and work well with cross-functional teams under pressure.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax topics to non-tax executives.
  • Proven track record in a dynamic environment, comfortable leading through change.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience leading tax teams within a public SaaS or high-growth technology company.
  • Proven track record of managing complex international tax structures and M&A transactions.
  • Workiva platform experience.
  • Master’s degree in Taxation (MST).

Travel Requirement & Working Conditions


  • Up to 10% travel required for strategic team meetings and corporate events.
  • Remote workspace setup.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $185,000.00 - $315,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

The Sales Executive orchestrates internal teams to develop and present compelling, client-specific solutions that address prospect needs and differentiate Rackspace in the marketplace. The successful candidate will understand how Private Equity firms create value across portfolio companies and be comfortable engaging Operating Partners, Value Creation leaders, Portfolio CEOs and Private Equity sponsors in discussions around growth, operational performance, transformation and enterprise value creation.

You will use your Private Equity expertise to uncover business problems, identify where AI can create value and develop opportunities that may not already exist. A critical part of this role is the ability to identify where AI can solve real business challenges within portfolio companies and value creation programs. We're looking for someone with experience selling AI-led transformation to business stakeholders who understands how to move the conversation beyond technology and connect it directly to measurable business outcomes.


What You'll Do

  • Hunt, develop and close net-new enterprise opportunities centred on Private Equity, Value Creation and AI-led transformation.
  • Build a high-quality pipeline through targeted prospecting, executive networking, industry relationships and strategic account development.
  • Establish trusted relationships with Operating Partners, Managing Directors, Portfolio CEOs, CFOs and Value Creation leaders.
  • Lead executive-level discovery conversations to uncover business challenges, transformation priorities and opportunities for AI, data and automation to drive measurable business value.
  • Translate business needs into compelling business cases, transformation programmes and solution opportunities.
  • Orchestrate Rackspace AI, data, cloud, applications and services teams to design and deliver tailored client solutions.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying cycles from initial engagement through commercial negotiation and contract signature.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process, maintaining accurate pipeline, forecasting and CRM data.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed new-logo bookings, revenue and profitability targets while ensuring a seamless handover to client partners for ongoing relationship management.

Experience We're Looking For


  • Senior quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.
  • A demonstrable track record of generating net-new pipeline and winning new customers.
  • Deep domain fluency within Private Equity, portfolio operations or value creation.
  • Proven experience selling AI, data, analytics or AI-enabled transformation solutions.
  • Experience selling AI-enabled transformation programmes directly to Line of Business executives.
  • Credibility engaging Operating Partners, Managing Directors, Portfolio CEOs, CFOs and senior business leaders.
  • Evidence of personally creating opportunities rather than primarily responding to established demand.
  • Ability to connect business challenges to measurable financial and operational outcomes, including EBITDA growth and enterprise value creation.
  • Experience navigating complex, consultative enterprise sales cycles.
  • Strong executive presence, commercial acumen and negotiation skills.

The Person We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can walk into a first meeting with an Operating Partner, Portfolio CEO or Value Creation leader and have a credible conversation about EBITDA growth, operational efficiency, revenue acceleration, working capital, transformation priorities and enterprise value creation.

You'll understand how to uncover where the organization is struggling and then ask:


Where could AI materially change this outcome?”.


From there, you'll be able to move the customer through:


Challenge → AI opportunity → business case → executive sponsorship → transformation engagement.


Rackspace can surround you with deep AI, cloud, engineering and delivery expertise. You bring the Private Equity credibility, executive relationships, commercial instincts and ability to convert strategic conversations into net-new revenue opportunities.

Why Join Rackspace?

This is an opportunity to help define and build a high-growth go-to-market motion focused on AI-led value creation within the Private Equity community.

You'll work directly with senior investment professionals, value creation leaders and portfolio executives, helping them unlock measurable business outcomes through the application of AI, data and modern technology platforms.

For a high-performing seller with Private Equity credibility and AI transformation experience, this is an opportunity to shape a category-defining go-to-market motion, influence executive agendas and create transformational business outcomes across some of the world's most ambitious investment-backed organisations.


Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. The compensation range for this position ranges from $192,610.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 338,993.60 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Learn more about benefits at Rackspace.

About Rackspace Technology

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.


More on Rackspace Technology

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Project Management Specialist to join our team! The Project Management Specialist supports Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) project delivery by coordinating activities, tracking progress, and coordinating engagement and communication across stakeholders. The role plans and monitors project components and provides reporting to support timely completion of project deliverables that are in alignment with organizational goals and community needs.

  • Track project progress and maintain schedules, milestones, and action items.

  • Coordinate communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Promote equity-focused and community-informed project practices.
  • Identify project risks and issues and escalate as appropriate.

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules available for some positions with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED and six (6) years of experience in Health or Human Services, Social Services, or Business field, coordinating projects and/or facilitating stakeholder engagement; OR
  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of experience in Health or Human Services, Social Services, or Business field, coordinating projects and/or facilitating stakeholder engagement; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of experience in Health or Human Services, Social Services, or Business field, coordinating projects and/or facilitating stakeholder engagement; OR

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for employment now or in the future (ex: OPT F-1, J-1).

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher

  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

raw.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Social Media Manager & Video Editor

Compensation range: $900 AUD - $1,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to require roughly 20 hours per week. As a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your schedule, but availability for occasional collaboration during AU business hours is preferred.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines.. You will be hired directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian-based premium distributor partnering with professional haircare brands that are known for innovation, quality, and sustainability. Rather than simply supplying products, they focus on helping salon owners and stylists grow thriving businesses through education, support, and long-term partnerships.

Working closely with creative professionals across the industry, they champion brands that inspire artistry, encourage individuality, and deliver meaningful results. Their mission is to empower salon businesses to achieve greater success—both creatively and commercially—by providing the tools, knowledge, and support needed to grow with confidence.

Role Overview: We’re looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Manager & Video Editor to manage multiple social media accounts of the client. You’ll turn raw footage of hair transformations, product features, educational sessions, and industry events into polished, engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok, while managing content calendars, captions, publishing, and community engagement across several brand accounts.

You’ll also build the business’s TikTok presence from the ground up and support the founder’s LinkedIn content. Working closely with the in-house marketing team, you’ll help maintain consistent brand identities, grow engagement with hairdressers and salon owners, and use creative ideas and AI tools to improve content. As the business grows, there may be opportunities to take on broader marketing responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.
  • Adapt video pacing, length, hooks, and formats to suit each platform.
  • Create content featuring hair transformations, educational tips, product features, behind-the-scenes footage, and industry events.
  • Add captions, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound effects while maintaining each brand’s visual identity.
  • Colour-correct and grade footage to ensure hair colour and products look accurate and premium.
  • Repurpose longer videos, educational sessions, and event footage into multiple short-form clips.
  • Use AI tools to streamline editing, generate ideas, and improve content quality.

Social Media Management

  • Manage the main Instagram account and multiple brand-specific social media accounts.
  • Plan and maintain content calendars across all accounts.
  • Write engaging captions that resonate with hairdressers and salon owners.
  • Schedule and publish content consistently across platforms.
  • Maintain consistent content quality, brand voice, and presentation across all accounts.

Community Engagement

  • Respond promptly to comments and direct messages in the appropriate brand voice.
  • Monitor tagged posts and engage with relevant salon and client content.
  • Proactively comment on, share, and interact with posts from the salon community.
  • Build relationships with hairdressers and salon owners to grow engagement across accounts.

TikTok Growth

  • Build and grow the business’s TikTok presence from the ground up.
  • Monitor trends, sounds, and content formats, adapting relevant ideas to suit each brand.

LinkedIn Content Support

  • Assist with managing the founder’s personal LinkedIn profile.
  • Repurpose relevant content from other social channels into posts suited to a professional audience.

Requirements

Must have:

  • 2–3 years minimum experience in video editing and social media management for brands
  • A strong portfolio of short-form video content (Reels and TikTok) showing high-quality editing
  • Advanced skills in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve
  • Solid working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok, including Reels, Stories, trends, algorithms and insights
  • Experience managing multiple brand accounts at once, each with its own voice
  • A strong eye for aesthetics, with a feel for how hair, colour and product should look on camera
  • Clear understanding of how tone and content differ across Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn
  • Great written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Organised, reliable and self-directed, with strong attention to detail
  • Availability during South Australian business hours

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the hair, beauty or fashion industry, as is a genuine passion for the space
  • Experience using AI tools for video editing and content creation
  • Broader marketing or marketing management experience
  • Familiarity with social scheduling tools such as Meta Business Suite, Later or Planoly

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that may be set up as either an independent contractor engagement or via an Employer of Record (EOR), depending on client preferences and legal structure.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Be available for meetings and collaboration during core [AEST or PHT] business hours
  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor” if not employed via EOR)

SOBRE A CERTSYS

ACertsysé uma empresa especializada em Transformação Digital que, desde 2007, apoia organizações por meio de soluções tecnológicas inovadoras e escaláveis. Com uma cultura colaborativa, ágil e transparente, tem como propósito revolucionar negócios e impactar pessoas por meio da tecnologia. Além disso, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil, sendo certificada pelo GPTW por dois anos consecutivos.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Gestão do Projeto

    Acompanhar o cronograma oficial do projeto, comparando realizado x planejado por pacote e por fase;
    Gerenciar riscos, escopo e os planos de contingência de prazo, equipe e escopo;
    Conduzir reuniões de status semanais com GTI, NTD e os desenvolvedores dos pacotes;
    Elaborar relatórios executivos mensais de status para a alta administração;
    Escalonar imediatamente para NTD/GTI desvios superiores a 15% no prazo de qualquer pacote;
    Coordenar os checkpoints de homologação e a aprovação de go-live de cada pacote.

Análise de Negócio / Sistemas

    Levantar e documentar, junto às áreas usuárias, os requisitos funcionais e as regras de negócio dos sistemas a serem migrados;
    Validar e manter atualizado o inventário de sistemas (telas, relatórios, complexidade), identificando divergências entre o escopo mapeado e a realidade de cada sistema;
    Mapear os processos de negócio impactados pela migração e definir, junto às áreas, os critérios de aceite e homologação por sistema;
    Conduzir o piloto de calibração de esforço (migração de amostra de telas e relatórios) para validar as estimativas de esforço por pacote;
    Elaborar e manter a documentação técnico-funcional dos sistemas migrados;
    Organizar e planejar os testes de homologação, validando a aderência funcional entre o sistema legado e a versão migrada em Forms 12c.

VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de TI, preferencialmente de migração ou modernização de sistemas legados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de cronograma (MS Project ou equivalente).
  • Conhecimento de gestão de riscos, análise de viabilidade (esforço x capacidade) e planos de contingência.
  • Experiência em governança de projetos: reuniões de status, relatórios executivos e escalonamento de desvios.
  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em gestão de projetos de TI de porte comparável.

VOCÊ SE DESTACA SE TIVER:

  • Conhecimento técnico sobre Oracle Forms e processos de migração entre versões.
  • Certificação em gestão de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2 ou similar).
  • Experiência com equipes mistas (recursos internos + temporários contratados).
  • Vivência em órgãos públicos ou entidades do sistema S.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA:

  • Graduação na área de TI ou graduação em qualquer área acompanhada de pós-graduação em TI.

raw.description:
Come join a growing financial technology company that's leading the marketplace in both the marketing and servicing of credit cards! Continental Finance Company specializes in credit card options for consumers with less than perfect credit.

We are seeking a creative UI Developer with a passion for building intuitive, polished user experiences to support our Technology team. We are seeking a UI Developer with strong experience in React, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end architecture. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining responsive, accessible, high-performance user interfaces for our customer-facing and internal applications. You'll work closely with product, design, and back-end engineers (who work primarily in .NET Core and AWS) to turn ideas into seamless digital experiences. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced setting, can work independently, has a strong eye for detail, and contributes to front-end architecture and UI standards across teams. This position will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with our financial services products.

Essential Functions

  • Design, develop, and maintain modern, responsive web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Build reusable, well-structured component libraries and contribute to a consistent design system.
  • Translate wireframes, mockups, and design specs (e.g., Figma) into pixel-accurate, accessible user interfaces.
  • Manage application state and data flow using tools such as Redux, React Query, Context, or similar.
  • Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs and microservices built on .NET Core and AWS.
  • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility.
  • Ensure UI accessibility (WCAG) and usability best practices are followed.
  • Contribute to mobile experiences using React Native as needed.
  • Implement secure front-end coding practices aligned with financial services industry standards.
  • Participate in front-end architecture discussions and help define UI standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with product, design, business, and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, including unit and component tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or similar).
  • Troubleshoot production issues and provide technical leadership on UI-related matters when needed. Required

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on front-end/UI development. • Expert-level experience with React, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and modern styling approaches (Sass, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind, or similar).
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first, and accessible web applications.
  • Experience consuming and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with front-end build tools and workflows (Webpack, Vite, npm/yarn).
  • Experience with front-end testing frameworks and practices.
  • Experience using Git and Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Strong knowledge of front-end security best practices (XSS, CSRF, secure authentication flows).
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with React Native for mobile application development.
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET Core to collaborate effectively with back-end teams.
  • Exposure to AWS services (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, etc.).
  • Experience with Next.js or other React frameworks.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library.
  • Background in financial services or other regulated industries.

Why Continental Finance?

Continental Finance Company (the “CFC”) is one of America's leading marketers and servicers of credit cards for consumers with less-than-perfect credit. Since our founding in 2005, we have prided ourselves on corporate responsibility to customers in terms of a strong customer support program and fair treatment. With our success, we have also grown into an innovative financial tech company! With a state-of-the-art consumer marketing and servicing platform, we provide a variety of services to consumers when other financial institutions will not accommodate them. With more than 2.6 million credit cards managed and serviced since our founding, we pride ourselves on putting the customer first. We are not a chartered banking financial institution, nor are we a debt originator or a credit card issuer.

raw.description:
🕙 Role details: This is a full time role (40 hours per week)

💷 Salary: £29,000 - £35,000pa + Performance-related commission + Equity options

🌍 Location: We're a remote first team, based throughout the UK & Ireland. We offer the flexibility to work outside of the UK/Ireland up to 90 days per year, however you must be able to work and live permanently within the UK or Ireland, and able to travel to London at least four times a year for company meet ups and additionally as needed.

The role

We're looking for an ambitious, curious and commercially minded Partnerships Development Associate to join our growing commercial team and help bring Isla's technology to more healthcare organisations.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a career in consultative sales. You'll combine research and proactive business development with the opportunity to connect with NHS clinicians and decision-makers, understand the challenges they're facing and show them how Isla could help.

You'll take ownership of the early stages of our sales process, from finding and reaching out to potential partners to building relationships, running introductory meetings and demonstrating our platform.

This isn't just about generating leads or booking meetings. You will get to know the people you're speaking to, ask great questions and understand what matters to them. You'll learn to spot where Isla could make a real difference and work closely with our senior Partnership Leads to turn those initial conversations into lasting partnerships.

We're looking for someone who enjoys meeting new people, is naturally curious and loves getting to the bottom of a problem. You'll need the confidence to start conversations, the resilience to keep going when things don't work out and, just as importantly, the ability to listen, build trust and make people feel understood.

You don't need to know the NHS or other healthcare systems inside out. We're much more interested in your attitude, initiative and willingness to learn. If you're excited to take on responsibility early, develop your skills and play a part in changing how healthcare is delivered, we'd love to hear from you!

------

Who we are

Isla Health is a venture-backed health-tech scale-up, supporting our partners across the UK, EU and internationally. We have built a new category of healthcare technology which we refer to as the Digital Pathway Platform (DPP). Founded in 2019, we now support 25% of NHS Trusts and a submission of patient data is made on the platform every 20 seconds

As a company, we're all laser focused on enabling a scalable model of care which empowers healthcare staff and improves patient outcomes. The DPP supports this by setting up digital pathways which are remote-first and asynchronous. As pathways harness sophisticated automation, clinical algorithms and intelligent cohorting, patients always take the optimised route through their pathway, thereby delivering a step change in clinical productivity.

------

Over the next 12 months you will:

  • Identify and develop new opportunities: Research NHS organisations, clinical services and regional priorities to identify where Isla could deliver meaningful value. Take ownership of targeted outbound activity across email, phone and LinkedIn, finding thoughtful and effective ways to engage prospective partners.
  • Lead early-stage customer conversations: Build relationships with clinicians, operational teams and NHS decision-makers. Run initial discovery meetings, asking insightful questions to understand their challenges, priorities and existing ways of working.
  • Demonstrate the value of our platform: Deliver engaging introductory and clinical demonstrations of Isla, adapting your approach to different audiences and helping prospective partners understand how our technology could improve their services.
  • Qualify prospective partnerships: Go beyond generating interest to understand whether there is a genuine opportunity for Isla. Explore customer needs, relevant stakeholders, potential impact and next steps, ensuring opportunities are well understood before progressing them.
  • Build a high-quality commercial pipeline: Work closely with senior Partnership Leads to progress qualified opportunities, providing the insights and context needed to develop successful partnerships. Take ownership of follow-up and maintain momentum throughout the early stages of the sales process.
  • Develop your understanding of the NHS: Build a strong knowledge of NHS structures, clinical pathways and the challenges facing healthcare organisations, enabling you to have increasingly credible and valuable conversations with prospective customers.
  • Continuously improve our approach: Track your activity and opportunities through our CRM, share insights from customer conversations and use data, feedback and AI tools to make our outreach and qualification processes more effective.

Requirements

  • A consultative mindset: You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding people's challenges. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully and focus on finding the right solution rather than simply delivering a sales pitch.
  • Exceptional communication skills: You can write clear, concise and engaging outreach that cuts through the noise of a busy clinician's inbox. You're equally confident building relationships, leading conversations and communicating complex ideas to different audiences.
  • Commercial drive: You're proactive, motivated by results and enjoy the challenge of creating new opportunities. You're comfortable picking up the phone, initiating conversations and following them through.
  • Strong research and analytical skills: You enjoy getting to grips with complex topics, digging into data and identifying opportunities. You can connect the dots between an organisation's challenges and where Isla could add value.
  • Confidence and resilience: You're comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone, aren't discouraged by rejection and are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Ownership and initiative: You take responsibility for your work, manage your time effectively and follow through on commitments. You're proactive in finding solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Technical aptitude: You're comfortable learning new technologies, confident using tools like Google Sheets and interested in how AI can make your research, outreach and workflows more effective.
  • Collaborative, mission-driven approach: You're excited about Isla's impact on patient care, enjoy working towards shared goals and take pride in seeing opportunities you've helped create develop into successful partnerships.
  • Experience:
    • Ideally, you'll have at least one year's experience in a fast-paced, commercial or customer-facing environment, such as sales, business development or account management.
    • Experience in B2B sales, SaaS or healthcare would be beneficial.

We appreciate you might not meet all of the requirements for this position. If your experience looks somewhat different to the requirements in the job spec but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

🏡 Work where you do your best work either from home or at our office in London (Moorgate) 🏢

🕜 Flexible working times

🌍 Work abroad for up to 90 days per year

🏖️ 25 days annual leave on top of bank holidays. Plus, take your birthday off and another significant day off of your choice 🎂

🍜 Quarterly meal on us - enjoy £75 to treat friends or family

🧘‍♀️ Wellbeing allowance - £50 per month for gym membership/wellbeing activities or private medical insurance

💡 Salary sacrifice pension and access to Mintago for retail discounts, financial coaching, childcare vouchers, virtual GP and more

🎉 Enhanced parental leave to support your family when it matters most

🎳 Quarterly company meet-ups

📚 An annual learning budget to support your growth

📈 Share in our success with share options

💗 Work with purpose - you'll be delivering social impact through improved patient healthcare

🚀 Join at an exciting stage - we're a well-funded, rapidly growing health tech company tackling a global challenge

🌱 Help shape the future of Isla - your ideas won't disappear into layers of management. You'll have real ownership, real impact, and help define how we grow the business

------

What is the hiring process for this role?

  1. A video submission. Successful applicants will be invited to submit a quick video so we can get to know the person behind the CV!
  2. An initial call with one of our People Operations team - 15 minutes
  3. A short take-home written task
  4. A role play interview with one of our Partnerships Leads - 30 minutes
  5. An interview with our Director of Partnerships, Chris - 30 minutes
  6. A final interview with our Co-founder/CEO, Pete - 30 minutes

------

Diversity and Inclusion

Isla is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. We do not discriminate against anyone on the basis of their race, gender, disability, religion, national origin, age, or any other protected category. We choose to celebrate our team’s differences and see them as one of our most valuable assets.

Recruitment is not one-size-fits-all and we're happy to tailor our hiring process to better meet the needs of individual applicants. Please email with any requests for support.

Application Security Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Application Security Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$160,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, partnering with engineering teams to design secure systems, identify vulnerabilities, and reduce risk across our application portfolio. The role blends hands-on offensive and defensive skills with strong communication and collaboration, helping development teams build secure software efficiently rather than slowing them down. The ideal candidate brings deep technical security expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of shipping security improvements that meaningfully reduce risk in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct threat modeling and security architecture reviews for new and existing applications and services.
  • Perform manual code reviews, secure design consultations, and pair with engineering teams on hardening critical components.
  • Operate and tune SAST, DAST, IAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tools across CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive vulnerability management workflows including triage, prioritization, owner assignment, and SLA tracking.
  • Build paved-road libraries and frameworks that make secure patterns the default for engineering teams.
  • Lead red-team and purple-team exercises against internal applications and drive remediation of identified weaknesses.
  • Implement and operate runtime protections including WAF, RASP, bot protection, and abuse-detection mechanisms.
  • Design and enforce secure authentication, authorization, session management, and cryptographic patterns.
  • Partner with infrastructure and platform teams to harden container, Kubernetes, and cloud environments.
  • Develop and deliver application security training, lunch-and-learns, and onboarding content for engineering staff.
  • Respond to security incidents involving application vulnerabilities or active exploitation.
  • Track and apply emerging threats and CVEs that may affect the application portfolio.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Stay current with application security research and emerging defensive tooling.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Ten or more years of application security or security engineering experience.
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, common vulnerability classes, and modern exploit patterns.
  • Hands-on experience performing code review across at least two major languages.
  • Deep familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, and CI/CD-integrated security tooling.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and cryptographic primitives.
  • Experience with cloud security and modern infrastructure controls.
  • Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language for tooling and automation.
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams in an Agile environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, GWAPT, or CISSP.
  • Experience with offensive security tooling and red-team operations.
  • Bug bounty experience, public CVEs, or open-source security contributions.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM application security considerations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict compliance requirements.
How to Apply

raw.excerpt: About DonorsChooseDonorsChoose is an education nonprofit ensuring every US public school student has the classroom resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive.
raw.description:
About DonorsChoose

DonorsChoose is an education nonprofit ensuring every US public school student has the classroom resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive.

Founded by a teacher in 2000, DonorsChoose connects educators with a nationwide community of supporters who believe investing in students today will transform tomorrow. Educators request the materials they know their students need, and donors can choose the classroom, community, or cause they want to support. Since our founding, donors have supported 90% of US public schools. Every request is vetted, resources are delivered to classrooms, and donors can see the impact of their support through transparent reporting and updates from students and teachers. Raising $1.9 billion for classrooms, DonorsChoose has earned top ratings from Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and CharityWatch for its transparency, trust, and impact. Our dedicated team works from across the United States to turn resources into opportunities for students and teachers.

About the Corporate Partnerships Team

Our team raises funds for classrooms by building and executing philanthropic partnerships with corporations and renewing and growing those partnerships over time. Read more about our partnerships.

About the Role

DonorsChoose is seeking a Senior Corporate Partnerships Manager to grow and steward a portfolio of strategic corporate partners while helping evolve how we build long-term, mission-driven partnerships.

This is more than traditional account management. Our strongest partnerships create meaningful value for both our partners and the classrooms we serve. Success requires curiosity, commercial thinking, exceptional relationship management, and the ability to translate partner objectives into creative, measurable philanthropic strategies.

As a senior individual contributor, you will own a portfolio of complex corporate relationships who each contribute $250K+ annually, while helping shape partnership strategy, identifying new opportunities for growth, and contributing to how the team continues to evolve.

Primary Responsibilities

Build and Grow Strategic Partnerships

  • Own a portfolio of corporate partnerships, developing long-term strategies that deepen engagement and increase philanthropic investment over time.
  • Build trusted relationships across multiple levels of partner organizations, identifying new stakeholders and opportunities to expand impact.
  • Consistently identify opportunities for renewals, upsells, multi-year commitments, and expanded partnership scope.
  • Contribute meaningfully toward annual fundraising goals through a portfolio of sophisticated corporate partnerships.

Design Thoughtful Partnership Strategies

  • Develop customized partnership strategies that align partner business objectives with DonorsChoose's mission.
  • Translate corporate priorities into high-impact partnerships through creative campaigns, employee engagement opportunities, and storytelling.
  • Use data, insights, and impact reporting to demonstrate value and strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Partner with internal teams to ensure successful implementation while balancing partner experience with organizational scalability.

Lead Complex Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner across complex partnership engagements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, Finance, Impact, and Communications.
  • Anticipate risks, remove obstacles, and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Ensure exceptional execution from proposal through renewal.

Strengthen Team Capability

  • Share successful partnership strategies and contribute to evolving team best practices.
  • Mentor newer teammates through deal strategy, proposal development, and relationship management, using a B2B consultative selling approach.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partnership operations, processes, and scalability.
  • Bring an external perspective on corporate philanthropy trends, helping the team continuously improve how we engage partners.

Qualifications

You may thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience, including experience in corporate partnerships, strategic account management, fundraising, business development, consultative sales, customer success, or relationship management.
  • Have successfully secured and managed complex six- and seven-figure partnerships.
  • Are exceptional at building trust with senior leaders and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
  • Think commercially—you naturally identify opportunities to deepen relationships and create mutual value.
  • View feedback as not just a tool for development, but as a catalyst for action. You are someone who embraces constructive insights and shows visible improvement in your next iteration.
  • Are highly strategic without losing sight of execution details.
  • Are a master of prioritization, who thrives on turning ambiguity into execution. You know how to scope a project, balance urgency with thoughtful prioritization across multiple high-value relationships, and keep cross-functional teams moving in the same direction.
  • Enjoy collaborating across functions and are known as someone who makes teams stronger.
  • Care deeply about educational equity and believe philanthropy can be a powerful driver of systemic change.

Level Expectations

Senior Corporate Partnerships Managers independently own the organization's most sophisticated partnership portfolios and consistently deliver against ambitious fundraising goals. They shape partnership strategy, influence how the team approaches relationship management, and serve as mentors and thought partners to colleagues. While they do not directly manage people, they regularly influence cross-functional decisions, improve team practices, and help raise the overall quality of partnership work across the organization.

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation philosophy ensures that we are both externally competitive with tech-forward nonprofits of a similar size and internally fair in our pay practices. The following ranges represent the target offer range given the scope and experience expectations for this role.

  • The hiring salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000
  • We have a hiring salary range of $100,000- $120,000 for specific higher cost of labor locations, which include New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Seattle, Boston, and Washington, D.C.

Once employees are hired, everyone at DonorsChoose is eligible to receive annual performance-based raises as they grow in their role. We are open to a variety of experiences, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced or more senior than this job description as posted. If you don’t check every box listed here, or you know you’d bring additional experience to the table, we hope you’ll submit your application.

In addition, we offer full-time staff 25 paid vacation days per year and 11 paid holidays, a rich employer-paid individual and family health plan, a matching 401(k) plan (up to 5% of base salary), annual professional development stipend, and casual and flexible work environment. To learn more about what it is like to work for DonorsChoose, visit our careers page.

Hybrid Workplace and Other Details

In this role, you’ll have the option to work a flexible hybrid schedule in our NYC office, or to work fully remotely from CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, MN, NC, NJ, NY, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, or WI.

Candidates should expect to travel approximately 8-10 times per year, based on business need. Travel based on business needs including, but is not limited to, internal events such as all staff gatherings, as well as external events such as partner meetings, conferences, and other events as necessary. All work-related travel expenses will be covered by the organization.

DonorsChoose participates in E-Verify. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

An important note on communications: All messages from our hiring team will come from an official @donorschoose.org email address. If you ever receive a message about a role with us from a different domain, it’s not from us, and you should not reply or click on any links. We care deeply about your time, your privacy, and your experience—thank you for your interest in joining the DonorsChoose mission!

DonorsChoose Core Values

EQUITY
Combating systemic inequity is crucial to a brighter future for all. This reality fuels our ambitions and drives us to persevere.

INGENUITY
Complex problems require innovative solutions. We dream big, get creative, roll up our sleeves, and take action. We believe the best products can change the world.

HUMANITY
People are the heart of our team and the communities we serve. Our compassion informs our goals and how we work together to achieve them.

INTEGRITY
We strive to do right. We’re up-front about the facts. We boldly learn and grow from mistakes.

LEARNING
Education is the beating heart of our organization, inside and out. We’re curious. We listen. We know we don’t know everything.

GRATITUDE
We begin and end with thanks. We take joy in our mission, our communities, and each other.

To Apply

Please submit your resume and answer the application questions online. Since we’re trying to get to know you through our hiring process, we ask that you please refrain from using AI writing tools to craft your response to our application questions. A cover letter is optional and may be addressed to Alex Constas, Director of Partnerships.

A Final Note

The DonorsChoose team works toward a nation where students in every community have the resources needed for an excellent education. To do this we hire and support a diverse team of the best and the brightest talent available because it makes us more effective, high-performing, creative and resilient. If you are passionate about our mission, highly skilled in your field, and looking for a place where you can bring all of yourself to work, we want you.

raw.description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.

Come join us.

Job Summary:

We are looking for enthusiastic candidates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world challenges. At PsiQuantum, we are particularly focused on use cases of quantum computing in chemistry, drug design, materials science, and fluid dynamics. Along these lines, we are offering internships in the areas of quantum algorithms and quantum compilation.

Your work could entail the -

  • Development of quantum algorithms to solve impactful problems,
  • Optimization of ubiquitous subroutines in fault tolerant quantum algorithms,
  • Compilation of quantum algorithms to logical gate sets,
  • Incorporation of architecture-aware optimizations,
  • Estimation of quantum resources.

Prior work in the field of fault tolerant quantum algorithms and compilation is preferred, but enthusiasm for quantum computing is essential.

Desired experience and skills:

  • Currently studying for, or completed a postgraduate degree related to quantum algorithms, quantum circuit compilation, fault tolerance or another aspect of quantum computing OR 5+ years working professionally in one or more of these fields.
  • Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) and collaborative software development tools (e.g. Git).
  • A creative and adaptable approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team.

You will research existing products within assigned niches, identify market gaps and improvement opportunities, and develop enhanced product concepts supported by detailed analysis of competitors, customer feedback, and market trends. Your insights will guide the company in selecting and launching high-potential private label products in the premium outdoor and fitness category, where products are complex, design-intensive, and built for long-term performance.

This is a high-impact, analytical, and cross-functional role that combines market research, product strategy, and business analytics to identify and execute winning product opportunities.

About the Company:

The company is an e-commerce brand built around movement, energy, and family fun. Best known for its high-quality outdoor and fitness products especially premium trampolines designed for safety, durability, and joy the brand is expanding rapidly across global marketplaces. It values initiative, analytical thinking, and people who take ownership of their work. If youre passionate about e-commerce, innovation, and high-quality products, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of consumer-focused and enterprise-level product lines defining strategy, vision, and roadmap supported by internal and external analysis.
  • Manage the entire product lifecycle from concept through design, prototyping, testing, and launch, ensuring alignment with business goals and brand strategy.
  • Conduct deep niche and competitor research on Amazon and broader markets to identify opportunities for new products or improvements to existing lines.
  • Use data-driven decision-making leveraging market trends, customer insights, pricing analysis, and cost-performance data to guide product direction.
  • Perform deep-dive analytics on customer behavior, product performance, and category trends to uncover actionable insights.
  • Develop detailed requirements, product specifications, and user stories, ensuring clear communication with engineering and sourcing partners.
  • Manage prioritization and trade-offs between customer experience, product performance, and operational complexity.
  • Work closely with sourcing agents and suppliers (especially in China) to evaluate manufacturing options, ensuring quality, compliance, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand Managers, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to ensure smooth product delivery, launch, and adoption.
  • Define and monitor key business metrics (sales, conversion, retention, cost, ROI) to measure success and optimize product performance post-launch.
  • Prepare comprehensive documentation including specifications, manuals, packaging guidelines, competitor analyses, and user stories.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in product development for an e-commerce company selling on Amazon.
  • Proven ability to analyze market data and identify profitable opportunities in the outdoor, fitness, or consumer product categories.
  • Experience in business analytics, financial/strategic analysis, or data modeling for product or project decision-making.
  • Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative reasoning skills able to use data to drive actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with analytics, data visualization, and querying tools (SQL, Excel, BI platforms, etc.).
  • Creative and innovative mindset with an eye for design, functionality, and customer experience.
  • Engineering or technical background and strong understanding of manufacturing and sourcing processes.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating with global teams and suppliers.
  • Experience working with international suppliers (especially in China) is highly desirable.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work with flexible hours.
  • Competitive and timely compensation.
  • Opportunity to lead the early-stage development of new Amazon products.
  • Creative freedom and ownership over product concept development.
  • Make a visible impact - your ideas directly influence what we launch.
  • Collaborative and growth-oriented work culture.
  • Be part of a high-performing team scaling a global brand.

raw.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own our larger accounts and multi-phase programs, from signed contract through discovery, build, launch and the first months after go-live.

This is a senior delivery role. You are accountable for the budget, scope, timeline, and the customer relationship on every project you run, and you carry the conversations that come with them. We want someone who has already managed complex enterprise implementations, understands the challenges of ERP integration, and who has worked in a delivery model where AI does a meaningful share of the work. In this model, you understand that the project manager’s job is to make sure the work is defined well enough for AI and human steps to flow smoothly and with minimal intervention.

What you will do

  • Own the project from signature to post-launch and deliver it on time, in scope, and on budget.

  • Turn the contract into a work breakdown with estimates that roll up to the sold number, and close discovery with the Solution Architect on that basis.

  • Keep the backlog ready. Every piece of work has a trace to the agreed solution design, acceptance criteria, an estimate and its dependencies before it goes to the team.

  • Keep the project record complete, with every project meeting recorded and filed so the design, the plan and the team’s AI tools can work from it.

  • Run the project week to week. Record and communicate budget burn, risks and mitigations, blockers with an owner and a date, dependencies on the customer’s IT and ERP partners, and a status the sponsor can act on without a call.

  • Carry the hard conversations. When scope or expectations drift, say what it costs, defend the team’s estimate and the agreed scope, and route the rest through change control.

  • Keep the customer relationship and the team healthy through the hard parts. The sponsor and customer trust your numbers, and the team trusts you to protect their estimates and their time.

  • Take the first call on customer escalations and bring rebaselines and change orders to the customer on your own.

  • Mentor Project Managers and build the templates, dashboards and working practices the PMO runs on.

What we are looking for

Experience and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Seven or more years managing software implementation projects with a contracted budget for enterprise customers, with commerce, PIM or ERP integration projects in the Microsoft ecosystem strongly preferred.

  • Experience delivering in an AI-accelerated methodology, where meeting records, solution design and backlog quality are what the AI tools and the engineers build from, and where you have seen what happens when they are not in order.

  • A track record of turning a Statement of Work and its change orders into a work breakdown that rolls up to the contract, and of holding that number through delivery.

  • Working knowledge of Dynamics 365 from the project side, enough to understand what the integration work is and why it takes the time it does.

  • Fluent with the work management, time tracking and financial tools a delivery team runs on, and used to keeping them reconciled.

Skills

  • Writes work definitions and acceptance criteria that a developer can build from without a conversation.

  • Delivers a firm message to an enterprise customer with the data behind it and stays in the room when it gets hard.

  • Builds trust with the customer and their team early, and keeps it through a firm conversation or a change order.

  • Reads budget burn and acts on a deviation before it becomes an overrun.

  • Holds several accounts at once without losing accuracy on any of them.

  • Writes updates a director or a customer sponsor can act on without a call.

  • Uses AI tools daily in their own work and checks what they produce before it reaches anyone else.

Who you are

You like owning a number and a customer relationship at the same time, and you’re comfortable being the person who says what a change will cost. You would rather define the work properly once. You have already worked with AI in delivery, you have an opinion on where it helps, and you want to be on a team that is putting it to work. You take ownership, build trust, drive innovation and succeed together, and you expect the same of the people around you.

Other information

  • Employment type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

  • Start date: Upon agreement

  • Location: Remote (U.S.), occasional travel for kickoffs and go-lives

  • Reports to: Director of Project Delivery, Commerce North America

  • Compensation: USD 80,000–100,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

About Truvio

Truvio is a fast-growing SaaS company that combines established Microsoft Dynamics ISVs into one product portfolio built for Dynamics 365, helping customers get more value from their ERP investments. With our core values Take ownership, Build Trust, Drive innovation and Succeed together, we are about 450 employees worldwide across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe Role The HR Solutions Enablement team builds effective, scalable, and cohesive HR solutions that minimize redundancy and deliver seamless data and insights for a better end-user experience.
raw.description:
Job Description

The Role


The HR Solutions Enablement team builds effective, scalable, and cohesive HR solutions that minimize redundancy and deliver seamless data and insights for a better end-user experience.


You’ll join a team that implements Workday and integrated third-party HR technology solutions to streamline operations and reduce friction. The team also provides Tier 2 support to business users. As the Sr. HR Technology Analyst for Hourly Compensation, you’ll design, configure, and maintain complex compensation processes across multiple countries and facilities, each with distinct requirements. This role combines consultative problem-solving, end-to-end execution, and the ability to influence without formal authority to deliver high-impact HR solutions.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration, consultation, and influence skills. You’ll partner with teams across the business to understand their challenges and implement optimal technology solutions—for example, translating hourly wage structures, step-progression rules, premiums, and allowances into robust, scalable Workday solutions that are accurate, compliant, and auditable.


The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience with Workday Compensation configuration, working knowledge of adjacent Workday modules, and a passion for continuous improvement and solution design. You’ll serve as a Workday subject-matter expert and solution designer who improves system effectiveness, user experience, and operational scalability. Familiarity with emerging AI-powered tools and agents is valued, particularly where they can improve the end-user experience, Workday configurations and business processes.


Flexibility is important, as this role may occasionally require work outside standard hours to support global stakeholders and critical projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and configure end-to-end Workday solutions for global hourly compensation, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, steps, eligibility rules, and plan assignments.
  • Configure and maintain complex hourly compensation components, including:
    • Base wage structures and wage scales
    • Premium pay structures and differential rules
    • Automatic step-progression schedules based on anniversaries, hours worked, or other business rules
    • Local allowances such as COLA, hazard, seniority, tool, transportation, and housing allowances
    • 13th- and 14th-month pay or similar country-specific components, where applicable
  • Translate requirements from local collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), country legislation, and compensation policies into clear, sustainable, and testable Workday solutions.
  • Design and maintain compensation eligibility rules using job profile, location, union or collective agreement, employee type, and other relevant attributes.
  • Lead or support projects to standardize and expand hourly compensation configuration, including discovery, design workshops, configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
  • Partner with Payroll and Integration teams to ensure Workday compensation configurations support accurate downstream pay calculations and payroll processing.
  • Collaborate with Reporting and Analytics teams to ensure hourly compensation data supports downstream reporting, compliance, benchmarking, and decision-making.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to hourly compensation, including eligibility errors, incorrect rates, step-progression defects, and missing allowances.
  • Execute and coordinate unit, integration, regression, and end-user testing; develop thorough test scenarios and maintain documentation describing solution configuration and expected outcomes.
  • Evaluate Workday releases and assess impacts to Compensation configuration, integrations, reporting, security, and business processes.
  • Apply Workday security and access controls, support data audits and control activities, and ensure configuration changes are documented, traceable and approved through established governance processes.
  • Validate, reconcile, and execute EIBs and other mass data updates in accordance with established data-quality and change-control standards.

Core Capabilities

  • Configuration and solution design: Independently turns complex hourly compensation problems into scalable Workday designs that balance standardization, usability, compliance and maintainability.
  • Stakeholder and consulting skills: Builds trust with HR, Compensation, Payroll, Labor Relations, and Technology stakeholders; clarifies requirements; and influences decisions with clear options and recommendations.
  • Execution discipline: Plans and delivers configuration work from design through testing, deployment, and hypercare with strong ownership and follow-through.
  • Continuous improvement and analysis: Uses data and root-cause analysis to diagnose issues and identify opportunities for process improvement, automation and better user experience.
  • Quality, governance, and controls: Maintains high standards for documentation, testing, change control, auditability, security and sustainable solution design.

Required Qualifications

  • You have 7+ years of progressive experience in HR technology, HRIS, compensation, or a related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on Workday configuration experience with a focus on Compensation.
  • You have advanced knowledge of hourly compensation practices, including wage scales, step progression, premiums, allowances, and related eligibility rules, and can model them cleanly in Workday.
  • You are fluent in Workday Compensation building blocks, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, steps, eligibility rules, and plan assignments, and understand how they work together.
  • You have built or supported Workday custom reports and calculated fields tied to compensation.
  • You are comfortable using Workday EIBs and mass-update patterns to safely move data at scale, including validation, reconciliation, and post-load review.
  • You can translate dense policy, legislation, and CBA language into clear, testable configurations and explain the logic to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have experience working across multiple countries or regions and navigating different regulatory and contractual environments to implement complex hourly compensation solutions.
  • You demonstrate professionalism, discretion and sound judgment when accessing sensitive employee information, using it only for legitimate business purposes and authorized work activities.
  • You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail, data quality, and root-cause analysis.
  • You manage your work independently in a structured, change-managed environment and consistently deliver on your commitments.
  • You communicate clearly, in writing and in meetings, with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What Will Give You An Edge

  • You hold a Workday Pro certification in Compensation or comparable advanced Workday training.
  • You have supported large hourly or manufacturing populations and understand the realities of plant and operations environments.
  • You have translated union or collective bargaining agreements into Workday designs for pay, step progression, premiums and allowances.
  • You have worked across additional Workday domains, such as Core HCM, Absence, Benefits, Recruiting, Talent, or Advanced Compensation, to design end-to-end HR solutions.
  • You understand Workday security fundamentals, including domain and business process security, role-based access, audit requirements, and internal controls.
  • You have led or co-led multi-country Workday initiatives or compensation optimizations and are comfortable owning portions of a global roadmap.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to identify and responsibly apply AI-powered tools or agents, such as copilots, chatbots, or automation frameworks, to improve the end-user experience, Workday configurations and business processes.

Compensation: The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.
• The salary range for this role is $105,600 to $140,700. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
• Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.

Benefits:

• Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).This role is based remotely, but if the selected candidate lives within a specific mile radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week {or other frequency dictated by your manager}.This job is not eligible for relocation benefits. Any relocation costs would be the responsibility of the selected candidate.

About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Benefits Overview

From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources.

Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)

General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.

All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.

We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire.

Accommodations

General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, emailus or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
