raw.description:
The SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Functional Lead Analyst provides functional leadership for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of SAP MDG processes and solutions. This role leads business requirements, functional design, governance alignment, testing, and stakeholder decision-making across master data domains. The MDG Functional Lead translates business needs into scalable SAP MDG solutions while guiding the technical teams responsible for configuration, integrations, and development. This is a functional leadership role, not a primary ABAP development position. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as the SAP MDG functional lead and subject matter expert for assigned master data domains. Lead discovery, requirements, process design, and functional solution workshops with business and IT stakeholders. Translate business and governance requirements into functional specifications, process designs, and acceptance criteria. Own functional solution decisions and recommend scalable, supportable SAP MDG approaches that balance business value, user experience, and complexity.

Define functional requirements for MDG data models, workflows, business rules, validations, search, duplicate checks, and replication. Provide functional guidance to technical teams responsible for configuration, integrations, interfaces, and custom development; review delivered solutions for alignment with approved designs.

Lead functional delivery for Material, Business Partner (Customer and Supplier), and/or Finance master data domains. Apply deep knowledge of domain processes, data dependencies, controls, and governance requirements to solution decisions.

Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and process leaders to define priorities and improve master data processes. Translate data governance policies into functional controls, validations, approvals, and data quality requirements. Lead cross-functional analysis and resolution of recurring process and data quality issues.

Own the functional test strategy, scenarios, expected results, defect triage, and business acceptance for unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing. Validate end-to-end MDG processes and confirm solutions meet approved business and governance requirements. Provide functional leadership for data migration readiness, validation, and business sign-off during phased SAP rollouts. Maintain functional design, decision, process, and testing documentation.

Lead continuous improvement of workflows, user experience, governance controls, and process efficiency. Represent the functional workstream in upgrades, enhancements, rollout planning, and SAP MDG roadmap initiatives.

Mentor MDG functional analysts and support resources; promote consistent functional methods and documentation standards. Ensure functional designs align with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, and support standards.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university. 7+ years of SAP functional experience, including hands-on SAP MDG functional design, process configuration, governance, and testing. 3+ years leading SAP MDG functional workstreams, solution design, stakeholder decisions, and cross-functional delivery. Demonstrated ability to direct technical delivery and review configuration, integrations, and development without serving as the primary developer.

COMPETENCIES

Evaluates Problems: Evaluates and analyzes different types of information objectively to identify appropriate solutions; writes fluently, establishing the key facts clearly and interprets numerical data effectively. Technical Communication/ Presentation: Communicates with clarity and precision, presenting complex information in a concise format that is appropriate for the audience. Adjusting and Driving Change: Takes a positive approach to tackling work and embraces change; invites feedback relating to performance and deals constructively with criticism. Identifies the need for and drives change when required to achieve objectives. Focuses on Customers: Understands and anticipates customer needs and takes action to provide high-quality products and services to exceed expectations. Demonstrates Business Acumen: Demonstrates working knowledge of the market, economic, legal, and regulatory environments and how they impact the business. Agile Best Practices: Understands how agility is leveraged in IT ways of working. Adopts agile best practices as appropriate throughout the assigned work lifecycle. Responds to feedback quickly based on comments from internal and external customers and needs of the market. Bias for Action: Takes initiative and identifies what needs to be done and acts without waiting to be asked. Executes work in a timely manner. Suggests improvements to current ways of working.

BFS COMPETENCIES

Business and Financial Acumen

Demonstrates depth of understanding for the P&L and financial analysis Teaches business and financial acumen to others. Understands KPIs and how BFS makes money. Knows the different business segments and how they relate to one another. Understands customer sales and engagement. Demonstrates functional and/or technical expertise. Understands complex issues and demonstrates problem solving skills. Understands how to maximize business results regardless of industry cycle.

Results Driven

Holds self and others accountable. Communicates and sets clear goals with plans to deliver. Manages competing priorities effectively. Demonstrates appropriate urgency. Drives to exceed expectations in alignment with our BFS SPICE values. Embraces and follows best practices. Demonstrates self-starter, can-do attitude.

Strategic Thinking and Decision Making

Leverages resources and teams around them to solve problems and create mutually beneficial outcomes. Demonstrates willingness and courage to make tough decisions in a timely manner. Balances short-and-long term priorities Demonstrates proactive versus reactive thinking. Asks questions to identify root cause and analyze situations more accurately.

Servant Leadership

Demonstrates humility by putting others first. Builds trust-based relationships. Leads by example with kindness and respect. Collaborates well across all areas of the business. Advocates for others Actively listens to understand the meaning and intent of what the other person is communicating. Demonstrates authenticity and encourages others to do the same.

Emotional Intelligence

Demonstrates situational awareness – knows when and how to adjust leadership style in different situations. Demonstrates self-awareness – understands strengths and weaknesses. Demonstrates empathy – puts themselves in other’s shoes. Assumes positive intent.

Develops and Leads Others

Drives alignment through clear communication of vision, goals, and expectations. Invests time on a regular basis in performance feedback and developmental conversations. Fosters a respectful and inclusive environment. Empowers, motivates, and inspires others. Coaches and mentor others for their development. Guides and persuades others to deliver positive outcomes.

Growth Mindset

Demonstrates a growth mindset; takes appropriate risks, fails fast and forward, learns from mistakes. Perseverance and champions growth, even in the face of resistance, ambiguity, or possible failure. Thinks like an owner with an entrepreneurial spirit. Demonstrates and encourages intellectual curiosity. Continuous learner; seeks opportunities and knowledge for personal and professional growth. Sees possibilities over problems – actively seeks solutions.

Innovation

Encourages out-of-the box thinking to create new ways of doing things. Continuously seeks to improve and simplify pain points in the business. Anticipates, embraces, and leads change. Develops and executes breakthrough strategies.

Integrity

Does the right thing even under challenging circumstances? Communicates with honesty. Consistently treats others fairly and equitably. Demonstrates reliability and does what they say they will do. Conducts tough conversations and delivers difficult messages with kindness and respect.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Subject to both typical office environment and outside locations with temperature and weather variations. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. Up to 20% travel may be required.

raw.description:
Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that manages your entire infrastructure lifecycle — provisioning, configuration and governance. Spacelift integrates with all your infrastructure tooling (e.g. Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible) to provide a single integrated workflow so you can deliver secure, cost-effective, and resilient infrastructure, fast.

By automating deployment and configuration, providing developer self-service, golden paths with guardrails, and an OPA policy engine, Spacelift empowers businesses to accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control and governance over their infrastructure. Spacelift offers unrivalled support, no-nonsense pricing, and a range of deployment models to fit your specific needs.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms, including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

Spacelift is building the infrastructure platform that engineering teams actually want to use. We're growing fast, and the partner channel is a core part of how we scale. We're looking for someone to own it.Spacelift is hiring a Director-level leader to own GTM enablement across the revenue organisation. As Spacelift’s GTM motion matures, enablement is the function that determines whether the people in the field can actually run it. We’re looking for someone to own that end of it.

What will you do

  • Support customers across multiple channels, primarily shared Slack channels, email/ticketing, with live calls and screen-shares for complex or urgent issues.

  • Reproduce customer-reported issues and isolate root cause - reading logs, APM traces, and run history to tell a genuine product bug apart from a configuration issue or an upstream provider change.

  • Build trust, not just fixes. Partner closely with customers and with Product and Engineering so that every interaction strengthens the relationship rather than just closing a case.

  • Debug both SaaS and self-hosted deployments, including private workers, Rego policies, autoscaling, networking, and TLS/certificate issues.

  • Reason about IaC behaviour at the implementation level - how Terraform/OpenTofu and Terragrunt execute, how providers cache and resolve, how outputs and run states propagate - well enough to explain unexpected behaviour clearly.

  • Work with Spacelift policies (OPA/Rego) to diagnose and explain policy-driven behaviour.

  • Ask targeted questions to get to the root of a problem fast, and follow issues through to resolution within agreed response times.

  • Escalate to Product Engineers with a clean, reproducible case - minimal repro, relevant traces, and a clear articulation of expected vs actual behaviour.

  • Write clear customer-facing communications for incidents, platform changes, and migrations.

  • Prioritise and manage several open, technically complex issues at once.

  • Follow up to confirm the customer's setup is fully working after a fix.

  • Maintain and improve internal documentation and the knowledge base as you learn.

  • Feed patterns and recurring pain points back to Product.

  • Participate in on-call rotations for after-hours support

Requirements for the Position

  • 2 to 4 years of experience with DevOps (Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, Docker, etc.)

  • 2 to 4 years of experience with at least one of the main Cloud Providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Hands-on experience with Linux environments.

  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues.

  • Ability to provide step-by-step technical help.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Excellent written English skills.

  • Work experience as a Technical Support Engineer, Desktop Support Engineer, IT Help Desk Technician, or similar role is a plus.

  • Additional certification in DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Provider, or similar technologies is a plus.

Why Spacelift?

  • Innovative Culture: Join a team shaping cloud infrastructure management’s future.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be a key player in driving Spacelift’s business and AWS partnership to new heights.

  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible work environment, with remote-first options and competitive compensation packages.

  • Collaborative Team: Work with passionate, talented people committed to driving success for our customers and partners.

Hiring Process

  • 30-minute introductory video call with Nuria Requena, Talent Acquisition Manager

  • 45-minute interview with Danielle Murphy, Head of Support Engineering

  • Take-home exercise

  • Technical interview

  • 30-minute cultural call with a member of the Leadership team

  • Reference check

Our values

  • We build for CUSTOMERS

  • We RESPECT each other

  • We take OWNERSHIP seriously

  • We succeed through COLLABORATION

  • We embrace SPARK & WONDER

More here:

Join Us! At Spacelift, you won’t just be working on a technical product - you’ll be part of a team shaping the future of DevOps. Apply to contribute to a platform loved by its users and take your career to the next level!

MULTI GDS TRAINER SPECIALIST

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

Established in June 2004, FCM has been named World’s Best Travel Management Company for eight years running at the World Travel Awards.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About The Opportunity

Join a team passionate about travel, learning, and operational excellence. As a Multi GDS Trainer Specialist, you'll play a critical role in developing and delivering training that empowers agents to maximize their expertise across key global distribution systems, with a strong focus on Sabre. This role combines training delivery, program development, process documentation, and business support to enhance productivity and service quality across the organization. If you enjoy coaching others, creating learning resources, and driving continuous improvement, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Sabre training programs for both novice and experienced users.
  • Facilitate ongoing training and upskilling initiatives for existing agents.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance multi-course training programs and materials.
  • Create and document training processes, procedures, and learning resources.
  • Review and update training content to reflect new processes and system enhancements.
  • Monitor new Sabre releases and communicate updates, shortcuts, and efficiencies to end users.
  • Support adoption and training for Red Apps and related technologies.
  • Identify and implement efficiency opportunities through Red Apps utilization.
  • Provide RAP customer support.
  • Maintain the training library and ensure resources remain current and accessible.
  • Support the Customer Care Team with training-related assistance.
  • Create documentation and training materials for scripts and automation processes.
  • Monitor and respond to inquiries received through the training mailbox.
  • Deliver monthly "coffee break" learning sessions for agents.
  • Provide one-on-one coaching and support as needed.
  • Work independently to develop documentation, processes, and training initiatives.
  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of Sabre required.
  • Extensive knowledge of Amadeus required.
  • Knowledge of operational processes preferred.
  • Understanding of consultant workflow from PNR through reporting preferred.
  • Experience creating training materials, documentation, or learning programs.
  • Training or facilitation background preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Structured, highly organized, and detail-oriented approach.
  • Experience supporting process improvements and systems adoption is an advantage.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.

ICS.AI · Remote (UK)

Full-time, permanent

Salary up to £35,000

Turn ideas, client needs and AI opportunities into products that are clear, buildable and ready to deliver.

ICS.AI is the UK’s market leader in AI solutions for local government, partnering with more than 20 councils to transform public service delivery. Our products span AI contact centres, staff copilots and social care copilots, helping organisations improve resident experiences, increase productivity and deliver smarter services.

We’re looking for a Product Specialist to take ownership of one of our core products. Sitting within the Product team and reporting to the Product Manager, you’ll become the product authority turning client and business needs into validated specifications, a sprint-ready backlog and accurate product documentation.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the Specify process for core product builds, creating detailed specifications and AI-assisted prototypes.
  • Managing and maintaining the backlog for one core product in Azure DevOps.
  • Grooming, prioritising and sizing backlog items with the Product Manager so the backlog stays sprint-ready.
  • Writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria that support confident development, testing and release.
  • Producing and maintaining user guides, release notes, onboarding materials and process documentation.
  • Turning feedback from client user groups, AI Champion networks, QBRs and service tickets into structured backlog inputs.
  • Contributing to sprint reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement sessions across product lines.
  • Supporting go-to-market materials, feature descriptions and release communications.

What makes this role different

This is a hands-on product ownership role at the centre of how ICS.AI specifies and builds AI products. You’ll work closely with Delivery, Technical Leads, Engineering and the Product Manager, using AI-assisted prototyping to move from an identified need to a clear, testable and buildable solution. Your impact will be visible in the quality of the backlog, the clarity of the product documentation and the confidence with which features move into delivery.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience managing an Agile backlog and taking part in sprint ceremonies, typically gained as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a similar technology, AI or software role.
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and specifications.
  • Confidence using AI prototyping and requirements tools, including vibe-prototyping platforms.
  • A structured, detail-focused approach to documentation and backlog management.
  • The ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of GenAI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI—including a practical understanding of what AI agents can and cannot do.
  • A practical understanding of SaaS or AI product development, release management and versioning.
  • Eligibility to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

  • Experience as a Product Owner.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps Boards or equivalent backlog tooling.
  • Hands-on use of AI or vibe-prototyping tools to create working prototypes or specifications.
  • Experience of local government or wider public sector service delivery.
  • A Product Owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO.

The package

  • Salary up to £35,000.
  • Full-time, permanent role.
  • Remote within the UK, with occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites.
  • £100 per month working-from-home allowance.
  • Vitality Healthcare Plan.
  • Pension scheme.
  • 25 days’ holiday.
  • Support for relevant professional development and qualifications.

Ready to help shape AI products that improve public services?

Apply to join ICS.AI and help turn real client needs into clearly specified, well-documented AI products that teams can build and customers can use with confidence.

Salary: up to £35K

Job Title

Lead Integrations Architect

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Lead Integrations Architect
TDS Technology & Data Solutions | Reports to Global Head of Data Architecture & Engineering | Hybrid/Remote, US/EMEA hours

The role
You will own integration architecture across C&W's data and application estate as the firm's go-to authority. You will set the standards, design and build the hardest integrations yourself, and raise the capability of delivery teams around you.

What you'll do

  • Define and govern our integration patterns (API, point-to-point, hub-and-spoke, ESB, iPaaS, event-driven, bi-directional sync) and guide teams on when to use each.
  • Design end-to-end integrations across custom, SaaS and PaaS systems, covering data contracts, error handling, observability, security and scale.
  • Build the most complex, highest-risk integrations hands-on and prove them production-ready.
  • Create reference architectures and reusable components so teams build faster and more consistently.
  • Lead architecture on strategic programmes, owning design, sequencing and trade-offs.
  • Coach engineers through design and code reviews.
  • Steer the move from legacy point-to-point and ESB estates to modern patterns, with clear cutover and rollback plans.
  • Surface security, reliability and data integrity risks and drive them to resolution through governance forums.
  • Advise engineering, data, AI, product and business stakeholders, and work closely with Data Engineering, Security, Infrastructure and Architecture.

What you'll bring

  • Senior experience designing and building data integrations at scale across custom, SaaS and PaaS.
  • Hands-on depth across multiple integration patterns, plus .NET and C#.
  • Working knowledge of iPaaS, event-driven architecture and bi-directional sync.
  • A track record of leading through influence and setting technical standards in a complex enterprise.
  • Strong grasp of integration security, identity, observability and data governance in regulated, global settings.

Nice to have

  • Experience retiring legacy ESB or point-to-point estates.
  • Familiarity with API management, message brokers and streaming platforms.
  • Experience in a global data organisation across time zones.

WHY PATIENTS NEED YOU

Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. Here, you'll partner with exceptional colleagues across scientific, medical, and manufacturing teams, backed by advanced digital and AI-enabled infrastructure and the authority to accelerate medicines from discovery to delivery. Guided by our values of courage, excellence, equity, and joy, you'll have the opportunity to stretch your skills and build a career that evolves with you—across teams, roles, and the Pfizer enterprise. Join us to make history — for patients, for their families, for the future.


WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients. 


HOW YOU WILL ACHIEVE IT

This role will report into the Regional Business Director and will work with customer-facing and HQ teams across Oncology. The ABM will be responsible for the supervision and leadership of Senior Oncology Account Specialists within the area assigned, sales performance of the business portfolio of products, and business knowledge of the area landscape to assess key stakeholders plus future trends within the business marketplace. This position will require regular in field and virtual coaching and observation of Field Sales Representatives and frequent customer contact as well as the development of a strong, effective partnership with marketing and channel colleagues. The ABM will ensure compliant execution by team members, driving understanding of relevant policies and guidance and advancing a culture of integrity.


Responsible for supervising operations of the Area to include hiring, live coaching, virtual coaching, representative development, performance management, and the assignment of key "priority" accounts within the medical community, managing 6 Senior Oncology Account Specialists.

  • Develops and implements strategic plans for the Area, business plan, and overall responsibility for budgets at Area level in alignment with RBD expectations.
  • Plans, organizes, and monitors performance to achieve the business potential of the Area and the RBU.
  • Ensures effective utilization of promotional material, making valuable contribution to the formulation of marketing plans for the year, measuring efficient implementation of the plans in the field and undertaking regular assessment of marketing activities as an integral part of the total marketing operations.
  • Conducts proactive data analysis to identify market trends.
  • Collaborates, identifies, & motivates key account development and opportunities that impact regional/national business.
  • Build relationships with customers (including KOLs) and key stakeholders (including members of the Area and Region Management Teams, Channel Partners, and other cross-functional partners) and utilizes content appropriately for engagement.
  • Develops external advocates and contributes to advocacy and community engagement (as necessary).
  • Understands and champions the value of cross-functional collaboration to deliver on customer needs, while ensuring that compliance guardrails are respected by representatives.
  • Coaches' representatives on seamlessly connecting cross-functional colleagues reactively to address customer needs and how to use digital tools (e.g., digital triage app).
  • Effectively plan and conduct plan of action and other meetings with Area Management Teams, Channel Partners, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Collaborates effectively in an integrated account team.
  • Partners with Marketing in the development of the key strategies, business imperatives and objectives during the Op Plan process.
  • Ensures cross-functional partnerships within all of Pfizer’s Markets / customers to build up effective relationships and face-to-face selling.
  • Leads cross functional partnerships ensuring patient services are being met (as necessary).
  • Maintains enhanced product and/or portfolio, disease state, and market knowledge in order to respond accurately to all questions regarding products, policies, and business related issues from customers & reps.
  • Able to expertly operate digital and virtual tools/platforms.
  • Leverage’s insights from new analytics tools (e.g., 360-degree customer insights).
  • Demonstrates advanced communication skills (e.g., empathy, listening, asking probing).
  • Keeps systematic approach to virtual engagement (e.g., clear agenda, next steps/follow ups).
  • Retains flexible time management in environment (e.g., time allocation of F2F v. virtual engagements to meet business objectives to maximize HCP engagement across large geographies.
  • Works with all members of the Area Team to coach and counsel on improvement of performance and skill execution of selling skills, product knowledge, and capabilities needed for successful representative development, including the development of business plans.
  • Ensures actions of self and team are fully compliant; has complete understanding of all relevant compliance policies and processes; escalates issues, as necessary, and ensures appropriate commitment to integrity within their team.
  • Implements and upholds Area Standards with sales colleagues.
  • Applies situational leadership skills (e.g., knowing when to intervene and aligning coaching to colleague’s developmental level on customer engagements).
  • Employs multiple and interactive methods of coaching across all engagement types (e.g., virtual ‘ride along’, utilization of chat function while shadowing, F2F versus virtual coaching) to build rep capabilities and selling skills.
  • Builds strong team culture, colleague engagement, and morale.
  • Promotes a feedback culture and continuous improvement mindset in team to assess quality of customer experience (e.g., uses virtual pulse surveys, team barometers, customer feedback).
  • Set team goals and hold team members accountable for consistently exceeding those goals (e.g., brand growth goals, time management, technical knowledge, communication, compliance, use of technology and utilizing effective live and virtual engagements.

QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have

  • Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 6+ years of experience.
  • 5+ years pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical marketing/sales experience.
  • Skilled with data-driven resource management to ensure proper channel deployment.
  • This position will require travel as needed to develop internal and external relationships.
  • Strong communication skills including the ability to think and communicate with the audience’s need first.
  • Valid US driver’s license and a driving record in compliance with company standards.
  • Cross-functional collaboration mindset to facilitate ‘One Pfizer’ commitment to customer.
  • Model/Leader of excellence with change, agility, and adaptability.
  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Nice-to-Have

  • Master's degree with at least 5+ years of experience; OR a PhD with 1+ years of experience.
  • 2+ years of Area Business Manager Experience leading a sales team.
  • Experience working with key thought leaders or high influence customers in large group practices, hospitals, or managed care organizations preferred.
  • Oncology experience strongly preferred.
  • Hematology Oncology experience is Strongly preferred.
  • Advanced communication skills for facilitation, customer engagement, team management, and remote collaboration and coaching.
  • Demonstrated ability both to think strategically and to execute flawlessly to deliver results.
  • Strong track record of collaborative and motivational leadership and internal stakeholder management skills.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Devenez chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire

Accédez à des missions rémunérées de convoyage de véhicules partout en France, avec une organisation flexible et des frais de route pris en charge.

👉 Inscrivez-vous ici pour accéder aux missions :

DriiveMe est la plateforme leader européen du convoyage de véhicules. Chaque mois, plus de 20 000 missions rémunérées sont proposées à notre communauté de chauffeurs et convoyeurs indépendants partout en France.

Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar, et bien d’autres.

Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.

En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

  1. Vous créez votre compte sur

  2. Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

  3. Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

  4. Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

  5. Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

  6. Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Pourquoi devenir chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire ?

  • Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

  • Organisation flexible : vous choisissez librement les missions que vous souhaitez effectuer.

  • Frais de route pris en charge : carburant et péages sont remboursés selon les conditions de la mission.

  • Plateforme simple et intuitive : consultation, réservation et suivi des missions en ligne.

  • Missions partout en France : de nouvelles opportunités sont publiées chaque jour.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?

Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.

Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.

Avant de réserver une mission, vous connaissez les informations essentielles : lieu de départ, lieu d’arrivée, rémunération et conditions de prise en charge. Vous êtes libre de réserver uniquement les missions qui vous conviennent.

Profil recherché

Pour rejoindre DriiveMe Partenaire, vous devez idéalement :

  • disposer d’un permis B valide ;

  • être indépendant ou prêt à le devenir ;

  • être sérieux, ponctuel et rigoureux ;

  • respecter les procédures de prise en charge et de livraison des véhicules ;

  • être disponible pour réaliser des missions ponctuelles dans votre région ou ailleurs en France.

Inscrivez-vous dès maintenant

Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always.

Position Summary:

The Business Analyst, Data Operations is the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and AffirmedRx’s business-facing teams, particularly Client Management and Patient Care Advocates. Reporting to the Manager, Data Operations. This individual is the first point of contact when a client manager or patient care advocate identifies a file-related or data issue: gathering the details needed to understand it, conducting impact analysis to determine its scope and severity, and keeping every involved party informed of status from the moment an issue is reported through resolution. This role maintains a dashboard or similar tracking tool as the single source of truth on open issues and is expected to communicate proactively — no one should have to ask for a status update. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential, since this individual routinely translates between technical data operations work and the business teams who depend on it.

What you will do:

Issue Intake and Triage:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client managers and patient care advocates reporting file-related or data issues
  • Gather all relevant details needed to understand and scope each issue — client, file type, affected dates, impacted records, and related context
  • Accurately log and categorize incoming issues to support tracking, prioritization, and reporting

Impact Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough impact analyses to determine the scope and severity of each issue, including which clients, members, or files are affected
  • Partner with Data Operations team members (ETL Developer/File Management Analyst, Senior Data Operations Engineer, PBM Claims Adjudication Expert) to validate findings and confirm root cause
  • Clearly present impact analysis findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, tailoring the level of detail to the listener

Status Tracking and Proactive Communication:

  • Build and maintain a dashboard or similar tracking tool that reflects the current status of all open issues
  • Provide proactive, regular updates to client managers, patient care advocates, and other stakeholders — especially when work begins on an issue and when it is resolved
  • Ensure no stakeholder is left wondering about the status of an issue they reported

Cross-Functional Liaison:

  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and Client Management on file-related and data issues
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and Patient Care Advocates on file-related and data issues
  • Build trusted, responsive relationships with both groups to keep communication flowing smoothly in both directions

Documentation and Process Improvement:

  • Maintain clear documentation of issues, analyses, and resolutions for future reference and audit needs
  • Identify recurring issues or themes and flag them to the Manager, Data Operations as candidates for a systemic or process fix
  • Continuously refine intake and tracking processes to reduce friction and confusion for everyone involved

What you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of experience as a business analyst or in a similar liaison/analyst role; healthcare or PBM experience strongly preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate clearly between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to break down a reported issue and determine its full scope and impact
  • Experience building and maintaining a dashboard or status-tracking tool (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar)
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple open issues and stakeholders at once
  • A proactive communicator by habit — provides status updates before being asked, not after
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with both business teams (Client Management, Patient Care Advocates) and technical teams (Data Operations)
  • Familiarity with PBM eligibility, accumulator, or claims data a plus
  • Mission-driven, humble, and supportive; holds high standards while fostering trust with everyone involved
  • Aligns with AffirmedRx values, promoting trust, accountability, and innovation
  • Willingness to travel (10%-20%)

What you get:

  • To impact industry change in the pharmacy benefits management space, while delivering the highest quality patient outcomes
  • To work in a culture where people thrive because when OUR team thrives, OUR business thrives
  • Competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits

Note:

AffirmedRx is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Remote employees are expected to maintain a professional work environment free of distractions to ensure optimal performance and collaboration.

raw.excerpt: About LOVB (League One Volleyball): League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports.
raw.description:
About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Title: Youth - Social Media Intern

Department Code & Name: 203 - Marketing - Club

FLSA Status: Nonexempt

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) with occasional travel for site visits and business-related events
Job Level & Type:Individual Contributor

Job Summary:

The LOVBYouth Social Media Intern supports day-to-day content creation, publishing, and community engagement across LOVB's Youth social channels, including @lovbclubs and @lovbtournaments. You will help bring club, athlete, tournament, and community stories to life through engaging, on-brand social content that reflects the energy and culture of youth volleyball.

Working closely with the Social Media Specialist, Youth, you will help ideate, create, edit, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. In a remote setting, you will transform photos and videos submitted by clubs, athletes, and events into polished social content. During select tournaments and activations, you will capture and edit content in realtime and help showcase the athlete, club, and fan experience. This role is well-suited for a creative and organized emerging marketer who understands social media and is plugged into youth and club volleyball culture.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Publishing

  • Support day-to-day content creation and publishing across LOVBYouth social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
    ● Ideate and produce social content that amplifies club, athlete, tournament, and community stories under the direction of the Youth Social Media team.
  • Transform photos and videos submitted by clubs, athletes, and events into polished, on-brand social content.
  • Capture and edit photo and short-form video content using mobile and desktop editing tools, including Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, and Canva.
  • Write engaging social media captions using established LOVBbrand voice, messaging, and content guidelines.
  • Schedule and publish approved content according to established social calendars, priorities, and processes.

Live Event Coverage

  • Support social content collection and publishing during select youth volleyball tournaments, club events, and other LOVB activations.
  • Capture timely photo and video content that showcases athletes, clubs, competition, fans, and the broader event experience.
  • Edit and prepare social content in realtime using mobile or desktop tools to support timely event coverage.
  • Coordinate with Youth Marketing and event partners to understand content priorities and ensure appropriate coverage of assigned moments.

Community Engagement & Trends

  • Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and community engagement across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook using established guidelines and escalation processes.
  • Track emerging social media trends, platform features, youth volleyball conversations, and relevant cultural moments to contribute content ideas.
  • Identify and share compelling club, athlete, and community stories that could be amplified through LOVBYouth channels.
  • Gather basic social performance information and observations to help the Youth Social Media team understand content performance and audience engagement.

Required & Preferred Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong working knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, including current content formats and platform conventions.
  • Experience capturing and editing engaging photo and video content.
  • Experience creating short-form social video using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut.
  • Experience with light graphic design and photo editing using Canva, Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar tools.
  • Strong writing skills with the ability to develop concise and engaging social media captions.
    ● Strong understanding of youth and club volleyball culture and the types of content that resonate with athletes, families, clubs, and fans.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify social trends and translate them into relevant content ideas.
    ● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing content, assets, schedules, and deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while seeking feedback and direction when appropriate.
    ● Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
  • Experience building an engaged TikTok audience and creating compelling, repeat-viewing short-form content is strongly preferred.

Education and Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from an undergraduate program in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media,Journalism, Sports Management, or a related field preferred.
    ● Previous internship, academic,freelance, volunteer, or professional experience creating social media contentis preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and editing short-form photo and video content for social platforms.
  • Knowledge of or experience within youth, club, or collegiate volleyball is strongly preferred.
    ● Application must include a Gondola account link or social media portfolio demonstrating relevant content creation experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
  • Solutions-oriented and able to identify when to escalate issues or challenges.
  • Strong collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Capable of working independently while effectively partnering with a distributed, remote team.
  • Positive, proactive, organized, and creative - brings fresh ideas to problem-solving.
    ● Highly adaptable and eager to learn in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Curious about social media, youth culture, and emerging content trends.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and applying it quickly to creative work.
  • Brings a community-first mindset to storytelling and represents athletes, clubs, and families thoughtfully and authentically.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements (Remote):

  • Ability to operate a computer and use a keyboard, mouse, mobile device, camera equipment, and video conferencing tools.
  • Ability to clearly communicate via video, phone, and written channels.
  • Occasional travel is required January-July for tournaments, events, and activations.
    ● Ability to work occasional nights, weekends, and holidays based on tournament and event schedules and within the approved part-time hourly schedule.
  • Ability to work approximately 20 hours per week, with scheduling coordinated around business and event needs.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart(R).


About the Role

Parexel is seeking a Technical Consultant to join our Regulatory Operations team. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert for regulatory publishing systems, document management technologies, and electronic submission tools used to support global regulatory activities.


You will partner with internal teams, software vendors, and external clients to provide technical support, troubleshoot complex issues, execute validation activities, and ensure the effective use of publishing and regulatory information management solutions.


This position is ideal for professionals with experience in Regulatory Operations, eCTD Publishing, Regulatory Technology, or Regulatory Systems Support who enjoy combining technical problem-solving with client-facing consulting responsibilities.

What You Will Do

Regulatory Systems & Publishing Support

  • Provide technical support for regulatory publishing and submission management systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to eCTD publishing tools, document management systems, PDF creation, Microsoft Office applications, and desktop environments.
  • Configure, install, test, validate, and maintain regulatory technology solutions.
  • Support system validation activities, execute test scripts, and document results.
  • Maintain compliance with regulatory submission standards, publishing guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Manage multiple priorities while ensuring high-quality deliverables and service levels.

Consulting & Client Engagement

  • Partner with clients, regulatory teams, and software vendors to resolve technical challenges and deliver effective solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on publishing technologies and regulatory systems.
  • Support project teams by sharing expertise and mentoring less experienced team members.
  • Participate in client meetings and provide recommendations to improve efficiency and system utilization.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders while ensuring client satisfaction.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Must-Have Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • Regulatory Operations
    • Regulatory Publishing
    • eCTD Submission Management
    • Regulatory Technology Support
    • Regulatory Information Management (RIM)
  • Experience supporting or using one or more of the following platforms:
    • Veeva Vault RIM
    • Documentum
    • EXTEDO
    • Lorenz
    • Calyx RIM
    • Similar regulatory publishing or document management systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • eCTD submissions
    • Regulatory publishing processes
    • Global regulatory submission standards
    • Submission lifecycle management
  • Experience performing:
    • System troubleshooting
    • Software testing
    • Validation activities
    • User support
  • Advanced proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Office Suite
    • Adobe Acrobat
    • Windows operating systems
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Technology, Computer Science, Pharmacy, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing and executing validation protocols and test scripts.
  • Experience working within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulatory technology environment.
  • Prior client-facing or consulting experience.
  • Experience mentoring team members or acting as a subject matter expert.

Success in This Role

You will be successful if you have hands-on experience with regulatory publishing technologies and enjoy solving technical challenges while working closely with clients and cross-functional teams. Candidates with backgrounds in eCTD Publishing, Regulatory Operations, Regulatory Systems, Veeva Vault RIM, Documentum, EXTEDO, or Regulatory Technology Support are strongly encouraged to apply.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge regulatory technology and publishing systems
  • Exposure to global regulatory standards and best practices
  • Collaborative, matrix-based environment with opportunities for mentoring and professional development
  • Direct client engagement and the ability to drive meaningful business solutions
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

About the business:

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below. Insurance Risk Solutions

About the team:

Reporting to the Head of Sales Enablement, you will be part of a collaborative and growing team focused on expanding our presence within the UK insurance Claims market.

You will work closely with colleagues across Account Management, Product, Sales Support, Distribution, Technical Implementation and other areas of the business, bringing together market expertise and commercial insight to support the continued development of our Claims proposition.

This is an exciting opportunity to join LexisNexis Risk Solutions at an important stage of growth within Claims, taking ownership of a key commercial area while providing leadership to a growing Claims sales team.


About the role:

As Senior Business Development Manager - Claims, you will play a key role in expanding LexisNexis Risk Solutions' footprint within the UK Personal Lines Insurance Claims market, combining deep Claims expertise with commercial leadership, new business development and strategic influence.


As a Claims subject matter expert, you will act as a trusted advisor internally and externally, working with insurers and our Account Management organisation to identify opportunities, shape consultative sales engagements and progress new business. You will bring a comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end Claims process and use this expertise to support the continued development of our Claims proposition.


Alongside your commercial responsibilities, you will provide leadership to a growing Claims sales team and work across the organisation to ensure the commercial perspective is represented in strategic discussions. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership, building relationships across different functions and helping shape a developing area of the business.

Responsibilities:

  • Meeting or exceeding monthly and annual revenue targets, identifying and progressing new business opportunities across the UK Personal Lines Claims market.
  • Acting as a Claims subject matter expert, supporting the Account Management organisation in client interactions and leading relevant commercial conversations.
  • Creating and implementing strategic sales and territory plans, using market insight and Voice of Customer feedback to identify opportunities and help shape commercial strategy.
  • Building strong relationships with key decision-makers and senior stakeholders across the UK Claims market.
  • Contributing commercial and market insight to the continued development of the LexisNexis Risk Solutions Claims proposition.
  • Representing LexisNexis Risk Solutions at relevant industry events, staying close to market developments, competitive activity and evolving customer needs.
  • Collaborating across Account Management, Product, Sales Support, Distribution, Technical Implementation and other teams to support commercial success and client satisfaction.
  • Providing leadership, direction and support to a growing Claims sales team.

Requirements:

  • Extensive experience within Personal Lines Insurance Claims is essential, ideally within Motor Claims, with Home Claims experience also desirable.
  • A comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end Claims process, from First Notification of Loss (FNOL) through to resolution.
  • Strong commercial acumen and a revenue-driven mindset, with experience identifying, developing and progressing new business opportunities.
  • Previous people leadership or management experience is strongly preferred, with the ability to lead and support a growing team.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to build relationships and influence stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
  • Ability to work strategically and cross-functionally, while operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership in a developing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK Claims market, with an established industry network considered a significant advantage.
  • Ability and willingness to travel 30-50% of the time, including overnight stays.


Important Note :

Please note that extensive experience in the Claims area of Personal Lines Insurance is essential for this role. We are specifically looking for candidates with a strong background in one or more of the following:

  • Claims Management
  • Claims Handling or Processing
  • Claims Investigation

This experience must relate to Personal Lines Insurance, such as Motor or Home, and candidates should be able to demonstrate a strong understanding of the end-to-end Claims process.


If you do not have this type of Personal Lines Claims experience, unfortunately you will not be considered for this position.


Working for you :

raw.description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Manager, DevOps is a hands-on leader who sets direction, builds durable processes, and develops the team that keeps our cloud platforms reliable, secure, and cost-efficient. You will manage and grow the team while staying close to the technology, and you will be measured on the systems you put in place: how we plan, how we release, how we observe our environments, and how the team executes. The ideal candidate has built high-functioning DevOps practices before and knows how to bring structure and accountability to a team without slowing it down.

What You Will Do

  1. Own the DevOps roadmap and delivery commitments across all Supplier.io environments, serving as the single point of accountability for DevOps direction and priorities.
  1. Manage, coach, and develop the DevOps team and own hiring for the team as it grows, including defining roles, interviewing, and onboarding.
  1. Establish and enforce core operational processes, including change management, release management, environment promotion standards, incident response and postmortems, on-call coverage, and documentation and runbook standards.
  1. Bring legacy, undocumented infrastructure under version control and documentation, and own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including defined recovery time and recovery point objectives for our critical systems.
  1. Bring planning discipline to the function, including sprint planning, estimation, and clear delivery commitments.
  1. Define and drive the observability strategy, delivering centralized visibility across all environments with clear standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM, and owning the related tooling decisions.
  1. Own the cloud cost optimization program, including committed-use discounts, right-sizing of compute and databases, and reduction of logging and storage costs.
  1. Drive security and compliance hygiene in partnership with the security function, including least-privilege access, access reviews, key rotation, certificate automation, and vulnerability remediation.
  1. Stay hands-on: build and review CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes workloads alongside the team, and lead by example on technical standards.
  1. Partner directly with Data Engineering to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps their pipelines running: Snowflake account and warehouse administration, Airflow orchestration infrastructure, and secrets and connection management for data pipelines.
  1. Coordinate with the STAC on infrastructure decisions, such as cloud architecture, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling, that affect the broader platform, so infrastructure choices stay aligned with company-wide architecture standards.
  1. Participate in the on-call rotation alongside the team, especially early on, to stay close to the systems and set the standard for response quality.
  1. Build a culture of automation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the DevOps team and the broader engineering organization.
  1. Partner with software development, data engineering, AI, and platform teams to keep environments consistent and delivery fast, safe, and reliable.
  1. Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and make pragmatic decisions about what to build, buy, and adopt.

What You will Need to Succeed:

  1. 10+ years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles with progressive responsibility, including 3+ years leading or managing engineers with hiring, coaching, and performance responsibility.
  1. A track record of building processes that stick: change and release management, incident response, planning and estimation practices, and documentation standards in a growing organization.
  1. Experience bringing legacy or undocumented infrastructure under management, including introducing Infrastructure as Code and disaster recovery planning where neither existed before.
  1. Strong hands-on proficiency with CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, or similar), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm), and containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  1. Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform. AWS and Azure experience is beneficial.
  1. Experience defining and implementing an observability strategy across multiple environments, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM tooling decisions.
  1. Experience managing cloud spend, including committed-use or reservation strategies, right-sizing, and cost accountability.
  1. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to set clear expectations with engineers, influence peers across engineering, and present plans and results to executives.
  1. Judgment to balance keep-the-lights-on operations, project delivery, and longer-term automation investments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience building or managing distributed teams, including offshore execution teams.
  1. Experience consolidating infrastructure and operations across acquired platforms.
  1. Experience with security automation, compliance frameworks, and policy-as-code.
  1. Familiarity with CI/CD for data pipelines and AI/MLOps practices.

Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at

Job summary

This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI-assisted features and internal tooling.

You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

What you will do

  • Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
  • Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
  • Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
  • Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
  • Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services.
  • Integrate third-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
  • Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI-generated code alike.
  • Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

What you will have

  • 6+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them.
  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js, including a modern API framework (Fastify preferred, Express acceptable) and a React framework (Next.js preferred).
  • Production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. Depth in a single language is not enough for this role.
  • Solid relational database skills on MySQL or Postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior.
  • Comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence-led debugging in production.
  • Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
  • Clear written communication. You can explain a design, a trade-off, or an incident to engineers and non-engineers.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on AWS (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change Terraform.
  • Containers and Kubernetes at a working level: writing a Dockerfile, reading a Helm chart, debugging a failing pod.
  • CI/CD pipeline work in Azure DevOps or similar, plus Cloudflare or AWS WAF experience.
  • Grafana, Sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards.
  • Experience with PKI, TLS, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, DNS or email security).
  • OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect implementation experience, especially multi-tenant identity providers.
  • C# and .NET, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home.
  • Python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling.
  • Large-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them.
  • Building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic workflows in a product context.

  • Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP)

  • Paid parental leave and family support benefits

title: Associate General Counsel, Product & Regulatory
