raw.description:
Director of Data Strategy & Analytics


Job Location: US, Remote. Candidate must reside and work within the US.


Job Overview:


Lexia's data assets are central to how we grow and how we demonstrate impact. We are seeking a Director of Data Strategy & Analytics to lead the team that turns those assets into insight and action across the business, in alignment with our vision.


Reporting to the VP, Strategic Planning & Business Enablement, the Director will lead Lexia's internal business analytics function, directly managing a team of analysts and combining human analyst work with AI-enabled, self-service capabilities to maximize the use and business impact of our engineered data assets. The Director will be the primary analytics partner to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the Lexia executive team, and will own strategy and governance for our BI and analytics systems.


Reporting to this role is the leader of the Data Engineering team, responsible for data infrastructure and architecture. The Director of Data Strategy & Analytics will provide strategic leadership across both analytics and data engineering to ensure our data ecosystem enables business insights while maintaining the integrity, security, and confidentiality of enterprise data assets.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Team Leadership & Development

    • Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for data and analytics that aligns with the organization's mission, vision, and strategy, leveraging data to optimize decision-making, increase operational efficiency, and maximize impact.
    • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts, providing regular feedback and fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
    • Own project management and prioritization for all business analytics work, including analyst and AI-enabled analytics projects, and oversee review and QA to ensure data products meet high standards for quality/accuracy, user-centricity, and action-oriented data storytelling.
    • Support the Director of Analytics Engineering and foster a culture of continuous learning and development across the Data Strategy & Analytics team, promoting collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

  • Business Analytics & Insights

    • Drive analyst efforts to mine revenue, operational, and customer data and turn them into insightful KPIs, models, and dashboards that help our teams pursue revenue optimization and operational efficiency.
    • Partner with stakeholder teams across the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data to drive innovation and improve operational efficiency.

  • Self-Service & AI-Enabled Analytics

    • Develop and maintain a scalable suite of self-service dashboards, AI agents, and conversational interfaces that enable non-technical staff to ask and answer questions of our data directly.
    • Establish enablement frameworks for self-service analytics that drive adoption, empower users, and provide guardrails to ensure effective and appropriate use.
    • In partnership with Analytics Engineering, oversee the integration of AI capabilities into analytics tools and workflows to scale self-service and operational efficiency.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Serve as the main point of contact and key data partner for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior leadership, ensuring the alignment of analytics efforts with business needs and priorities.
    • Serve as the main point of contact for Cambium and Veritas analytics requests and collaborations, delegating to and partnering with the Director of Analytics Engineering as appropriate.
    • Translate business needs into clear downstream data requirements and metric definitions, partnering with the Director of Analytics Engineering to ensure the right data warehouse marts and Tableau Cloud data sources are provisioned, and providing input into data architecture, integration, and AI infrastructure decisions.

  • Analytics Systems, Tools & Governance

    • Own Tableau/BI system strategy and governance, in collaboration with other analyst teams across the organization.
    • Lead vendor and tool procurement and management for analytics systems and team tools, in consultation with the Director of Analytics Engineering.
    • Chair Lexia's cross-functional data governance group, collaborating closely with Legal, IT, and data leads to establish and maintain data and AI governance policies, procedures, and controls, and own policy compliance and appropriate sensitive data usage across DS&A-owned systems, staff, and products.
    • Stay abreast of emerging trends and technologies in advanced analytics, AI, and data management, and provide strategic recommendations for business innovation and responsible use.

Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, economics, business, computer science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, data strategy, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering data-driven solutions that drive business impact.
  • 5+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading data analysts or analytics teams.
  • Exceptional leadership and management skills, with experience leading high-performing teams in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Excellent quantitative and analytical skills with experience in data visualization, statistical modeling/machine learning, and go-to-market domain analyses (e.g., campaign attribution, price sensitivity, account scoring, retention/churn analysis).
  • Professional proficiency in analytics and BI tools that align with our tech stack (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Python or R), and working knowledge of data engineering and cloud data platforms (e.g., Dbt, Redshift, AWS) sufficient to partner effectively with Analytics Engineering.
  • Experience owning BI platform strategy and governance, and managing analytics vendor and tool relationships.
  • Expertise in data management, including metric definition, data governance, and data quality management.
  • Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-assisted analytics workflows, such as AI agents, natural language query interfaces, or LLM-driven analytics, with a deep understanding of the data privacy, security protocols, and ethical governance required to deploy them, including hallucination guardrails.
  • Familiarity with sales and customer data platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and experience within a SaaS B2B or B2G organization preferred.
  • Excellent communication, data storytelling, and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Strategic mindset and the ability to manage challenging priorities across multiple stakeholders.

To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .

Remote First Work Environment

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.

If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.

The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.

As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).

We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

Our Commitment to You

At Consumer Cellular, recruiting is human. Every application is reviewed by a real member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe the people behind the résumé matter just as much as what's on it.

All official communication from Consumer Cellular will come from a @consumercellular.com email address or through our verified texting platform, which will only be used to schedule interviews. We will never ask for personal and financial information during the recruiting process. If you receive outreach that doesn't match these criteria, please do not engage and feel free to verify directly at .

Who We Are

At Consumer Cellular, we offer simple, straightforward, and affordable wireless solutions that make staying connected easier than ever. Our customers may come to us for the price, but they stay because of the exceptional experience our team delivers every step of the way.

We believe in rewarding performance, encouraging growth, and promoting from within. Our track record of internal promotions and career advancement speaks for itself. Just when you thought it could not get any better, we offer a base salary of $17 an hour with uncapped commission.

While this role is remote, you will still need to reside within 50 miles ofLexington, KY. Don’t worry if working on site is your preference, we have a seat reserved for you!

Job Summary
As an Inbound Sales Representative, you will be the first point of contact for customers reaching out to learn more about our wireless plans and services. You’ll use a consultative approach to understand their needs through discovery questions, provide tailored solutions, and close the sale — all while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

What You'll Do

  1. Customer Connection - You will be the introduction to the Consumer Cellular experience. Your energy, curiosity, and the ability to ask the right questions will help uncover customers' needs. By listening to the reason for their call, you’ll position Consumer Cellular as the reliable, value-based solution they’ve been looking for.
  2. Building Value - At Consumer Cellular, we say, “People come for the price, but stay for the experience.” Your role is what brings this to life. By asking discovery questions, you will be able to provide the best recommendations on products and services that fit both their budget and lifestyle.
  3. Overcoming Objections – You know that when you hear objections, this is an opportunity to build trust and ask more questions. You are able to overcome objections by addressing concerns and highlighting why Consumer Cellular is the smart choice.
  4. Closing the Sales by Welcoming Customers to the Family – You’ll recognize the right time to close the sale and add a customer. You are able to close the sale confidently by delivering a great customer experience and positively reinforcing the customer’s decisions.
  5. Integrity and Accuracy - Maintain accurate records using CXOne and other internal tools (don’t worry, we will train you on all of them). We believe in always Doing the Right Thing, which means making sure the customer’s wants and needs are not only met but that you operate with the highest level of integrity.
  6. Being a Team Player – We win together! We celebrate, we laugh, and we respect each other’s strengths and differences. At Consumer Cellular, team is not just a value – it is the secret sauce to our success.

What’s In It for You?

  • Uncapped commission – take control of your income
  • Career development – we promote from within
  • Comprehensive training and ongoing support
  • Be part of a winning team that values your input and celebrates your success
  • Work in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment where your efforts make a real impact

What you bring to the table:

  • Minimum 1 year of sales experience (inbound, outbound, or retail)
  • Experience in closing sales and meeting metrics and quotas
  • Strong communication and active listening skills
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • Proficient in navigating a PC and web browsers
  • Ability to think on your feet, ask the right questions, and close sales
  • A self-starter with a desire to succeed and grow within the company

Are you ready to be part of a company where your hustle determines your paycheck, and your potential is truly unlimited? Apply today and start building the career you deserve.

About Consumer Cellular
Founded in 1995, Consumer Cellular is the first wireless provider unapologetically built for Americans 50+. An approved wireless partner of AARP, Consumer Cellular is trusted by more than 4 million subscribers for affordable plans, popular phones and devices, and great nationwide coverage, all backed by top-rated, 100% U.S. based customer support. Based in Scottsdale, AZ, with 3,000 employees in company locations throughout the U.S., Consumer Cellular has earned recognition as the most awarded wireless brand for customer service. The company has been honored as #1 in customer service in its industry numerous times and, in 2024, ranked #1 in network coverage and customer satisfaction among wireless carriers byAmerican Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI). Additionally, the company has been featured12 times on the Inc. 5000 listof the fastest-growing privately held U.S. companies. Consumer Cellular phones, devices and plans are available nationwide through our company-owned neighborhood stores, online atConsumerCellular.com, by telephone at (888) 345-5509, and at leading retailers including Walmart. Connect with Consumer Cellular onFacebook,Instagram, andYoutube. for tutorials, features, applications, and company news.

raw.description:
The Mission Driver Enablement Center (MDEC) Infrastructure Operations Team at Leidos currently has an opening for an experienced Platform Engineer with DevOps proficiencies to support our Enterprise IT Operations Center. This is a great opportunity to work with an elite cross functional team of Developers, Unix/Linux Engineers, Middleware Engineers, DevOps, and Cloud Operations professionals. The selected candidate will operate on complex engineering efforts, influence technical direction, and help standardize Platform and DevOps practices across teams.

This role requires expertise in Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code, and DevOps deployment models. This position will support both internal and customer-facing projects involving, but not limited to, infrastructure platform management, application containerization, pipeline implementation and management, infrastructure as code development, automation development, and cloud migrations. Bring your own experience and work with our team to teach and learn while building, maintaining, and supporting our customers’ environments.

Primary Responsibilities

In this Role you will:


  • Develop, configure, manage, and maintain the Kubernetes (Red Hat OpenShift) platform running in AWS, including cluster upgrades, patching, monitoring, capacity management, reporting, compliance management and platform troubleshooting. Collaborate and Coordinate with DevOps, Development, and Cloud Operations teams to address hosting compute, networking, and storage requirements and maintaining platform availability and performance.
  • Partners with application development teams to deploy and operate containerized applications on OpenShift, providing guidance on deployment configurations, resource requirements, and CI/CD integration, and troubleshooting deployment and runtime issues while maintaining platform security and operational standards.
  • Lead proactive, data-driven improvements to the Kubernetes (Red Hat OpenShift) platform and supporting AWS infrastructure, using observability data—including reporting, metrics, logs, and capacity trends—to identify reliability risks, performance bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities. Provide technical direction, prioritize and implement improvements, refine monitoring and alerting, and validate measurable gains in platform stability, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
  • Design, Configure, Implement and improve GitOps workflows, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD integrations to automate Platform configuration and support repeatable application deployments.
  • Lead GitOps development pipeline designs, implementation plans, operational documentation, and continual improvement of containerization service implementations and designs
  • Lead implementation and optimization of GitOps workflows.
  • Work with teams, across Leidos and customers, to understand, develop, deploy, and configure Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, and DevOps requirements for existing and upcoming projects.
  • Working in an Agile process to plan your work into sprints and participate in daily scrum meetings.
  • Develop IaC and automation capabilities for use across customer environments.
  • Design, Configure, and implement container-based deployment solutions for enterprise applications.
  • Develop, Configure, and implement automation and tooling to improve reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Improve and troubleshoot existing container orchestration environments, primarily OpenShift.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform and deployment issues with minimal oversight.

Basic Qualifications:


  • Requires BS and a minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with a minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience, relevant experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Ability to obtain Public Trust Clearance, or greater.
  • Participates in team On-call responsibilities.
  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift, including setup, configuration, and administration
  • Proficient with Python or equivalent programming language.
  • Experienced in building and managing CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Tekton).
  • Experienced in Agile teams and using tools such as Jira for project and work tracking.
  • Proficiency in container technologies such as Docker.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform and/or Ansible,
  • Experienced with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Experienced with cloud-first, AWS/Azure native architectures and cloud PaaS & SaaS services.
  • Must be committed to adopting and adhering to DevOps Industry best practices.
  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team environment.
  • Mentor junior engineers and review technical implementations to ensure quality and adherence to best practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be able to effectively plan and prioritize tasking.
  • Capability to mentor junior engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Must be capable of performing high-quality work both independently, and with a team, in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to interact positively, collaborate and communicate appropriately with team members.
  • Obtain a baseline 8140 certification [IAT Level II) CCNA-Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+, CND, SSCP] within 3 months of hire date.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Kubernetes Certifications (CKA, CKAD)
  • Experience standardizing engineering objectives across cloud and containerization platforms.
  • Relevant certifications, such as Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration, Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
  • DoD secret clearance and 8140 Level II Security+ certification.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's Commercial business is building the path for advertisers and retailers to grow, and the Ads ecosystem needs a Product Marketing center of excellence to lead it. Without it, positioning, messaging, and the voice of the advertiser have no single owner to inform Product and the Ads roadmap. Twelve months from now, Instacart Ads has a consistent, best-in-market narrative and a scaled PMM function that is indispensable to the GTM motion.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Data Scientist with Imagine Pediatrics, you will be part of a growing team and business utilizing foundational Data Science to support the health and lives of children with special healthcare needs. This role is critical to understanding the power of our data and how we can leverage insights to directly impact patient care. You will:

  • Communicate with business stakeholders to understand goals, frame ambiguous questions, and scope projects into well-posed modeling problems
  • Build and deploy production-ready models, along with monitoring outputs and drift
  • Translate model behavior and outputs into actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences across the organization
  • Contribute to team ML infrastructure, including writing and maintaining code and dbt models for Data Science metrics and features
  • Work within our Data Science team and cross-functionally to optimize data collection, build data assets, proactively identify and close gaps, and deliver insights on business strategy, becoming a trusted analytical partner for external stakeholders

What You Bring & How You Qualify

First and foremost, you’re passionate and committed to reimagining pediatric health care and creating a world where every child with special health care needs gets the care and support they deserve. You will need:

  • 5+ years of experience, including proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Strong background in study design, causal inference, hypothesis testing, and research methods
  • Ability to work with non-technical staff and lead presentations of findings to colleagues across the organization
  • Ability to consistently deliver rigorous, high-quality modeling work end-to-end
  • Experience working in a start-up or growth environment required; healthcare experience preferred 
  • Experience with Snowflake, AWS, dbt and/or Tableau

What We Offer (Benefits + Perks)

The role offers a base salary range of $145,000 - $180,000 in addition to annual bonus incentive, competitive company benefits package and eligibility to participate in an employee equity purchase program (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors including job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

We provide these additional benefits and perks:

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA; Company-funded HSA
  • 401(k) with 4% match, vested 100% from day one
  • Employer-paid short and long-term disability
  • Life insurance at 1x annual salary
  • 20 days PTO + 10 Company Holidays & 2 Floating Holidays
  • Paid new parent leave
  • Additional benefits to be detailed in offer

What We Live By

We’re guided by our five core values:

Our Values:

  • Children First. We put the best interests of children above all. We know that the right decision is always the one that creates more safe days at home for the children we serve today and in the future.
  • Earn Trust. We listen first, speak second. We build lasting relationships by creating shared understanding and consistently following through on our commitments.
  • Innovate Today. We believe that small improvements lead to big impact. We stay curious by asking questions and leveraging new ideas to learn and scale.
  • Embrace Humanity. We lead with empathy and authenticity, presuming competence and good intentions. When we stumble, we use the opportunity to grow and understand how we can improve.
  • One Team, Diverse Perspectives. We actively seek a range of viewpoints to achieve better outcomes. Even when we see things differently, we stay aligned on our shared mission and support one another to move forward — together.

We Value Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging

We believe that creating a world where every child with complex medical conditions gets the care and support, they deserve requires a diverse team with diverse perspectives. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at Imagine Pediatrics are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
Sobi is hiring for 3 Sr MSL, Lymphoma (Lacutamab) openings. Candidates can work remotely anywhere in the continental U.S., with a strong preference that they're located within 30-40 minutes of a major airport.

As the Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Lymphoma (Lacutamab), you will serve as a field-based scientific expert on cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) and lacutamab, a humanized monoclonal antibody immunotherapy targeting KIR3DL2. You will build trusted scientific relationships, exchange balanced medical information, and generate actionable insights that inform US Medical Affairs strategy and launch readiness.

You will support Sobi's rare disease portfolio in the hematology franchise and serve as a trusted scientific resource across the hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology communities. You will collaborate with academic, community, and multidisciplinary care teams, always in accordance with regulatory, legal, and compliance requirements.

This is a field execution role within Hematology Medical Affairs. You will contribute insights and a field perspective to the CTCL medical strategy, which is led by Medical Affairs leadership.

What You Will Do

Scientific Engagement and External Relationships

  • Serve as a primary field-based scientific point of contact for Sobi Medical Affairs within your assigned geography.
  • Develop and maintain meaningful, two-way relationships with opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, medical organizations, investigators, and other stakeholders involved in CTCL care.
  • Exchange accurate, fair, balanced, and scientifically rigorous information on CTCL, lacutamab, relevant clinical data, disease biology, treatment approaches, and the evolving care landscape.
  • Engage across academic, community, and multidisciplinary settings, including hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology practices.
  • Respond appropriately to unsolicited scientific inquiries and connect stakeholders with Sobi resources in line with applicable policies and procedures.

Medical Insights and Strategy Execution

  • Identify, document, and share high-quality field insights on unmet needs, clinical practice, patient pathways, evidence gaps, stakeholder perspectives, competitive developments, and the treatment landscape.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs leadership and cross-functional colleagues to interpret insights and inform adjustments to medical strategy, tactics, educational priorities, and engagement plans.
  • Execute territory-level medical plans aligned with the US CTCL and lacutamab medical strategy, adapting engagement to local and regional stakeholder needs.
  • Support key institution and stakeholder engagement planning, helping establish Sobi as a trusted scientific partner in CTCL.

Launch Readiness, Education, and Congress Support

  • Contribute to lacutamab launch preparedness through disease-state education, articulation of unmet need, scientific exchange, stakeholder mapping, and field execution of approved medical tactics.
  • Provide internal and external scientific training on CTCL disease biology, preclinical science, clinical data, evidence gaps, and relevant outcomes.
  • Participate in or support advisory boards, medical roundtables, webinars, symposia, and other educational activities at local, regional, and national levels.
  • Represent Sobi Medical Affairs at scientific and medical congresses, and synthesize and communicate key updates and implications to internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate to identify and develop field resources and scientific materials specific to CTCL and lacutamab.

Evidence Generation and Clinical Development Support

  • Provide field-based support to Clinical Development and Clinical Operations, including site identification and recommendations, investigator engagement, communication facilitation, site initiation support, and patient accrual support.
  • Identify evidence gaps and potential research opportunities, and communicate them to appropriate internal partners.
  • Contribute scientific and field perspectives to evidence generation activities, real-world evidence initiatives, publications, and medical education programs, as appropriate.
  • Support investigator-sponsored research and other research collaborations in accordance with company processes and governance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Territory Leadership

  • Partner with colleagues in Medical Affairs, Medical Information, Clinical Development, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, and other functions, while maintaining the independence and integrity of the Medical Affairs role.
  • Serve as a scientific resource to internal stakeholders and contribute to cross-functional initiatives consistent with Medical Affairs objectives and company guidelines.
  • Demonstrate excellence in territory planning, stakeholder prioritization, documentation, follow-through, and management of multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Contribute to the broader Field Medical organization's success by sharing best practices, supporting colleagues, and fostering a collaborative, respectful, patient-focused culture.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is marked by:

  • Scientific credibility and curiosity
  • Strategic territory leadership
  • Insight generation and synthesis
  • Trusted stakeholder partnership
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clear, balanced communication
  • Agility and a solution-oriented approach
  • Operational excellence
  • A patient-centered mindset

What You Bring

Required and Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Accredited doctorate degree in a life-science, health-science, or basic-science discipline, such as PharmD, PhD, DNP, DSc, MD, or DO.
    • Candidates with another advanced health degree and extensive relevant industry or clinical experience may be considered.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of MSL experience in hematology/oncology or a closely related therapeutic area is highly preferred.
    • Experience in rare disease and/or product launch is highly preferred.
    • Experience in clinical practice, CTCL, lymphoma, dermatology, dermato-oncology, is valued.
  • Scientific acumen: Strong ability to understand, critically evaluate, and clearly communicate complex scientific and clinical information.
    • A hematology-oncology background is highly preferred.
    • Knowledge of CTCL and the multidisciplinary care environment is an advantage.

Skills and Attributes

  • Stakeholder engagement: Demonstrated ability to initiate and sustain credible scientific relationships and respond effectively to the needs of key stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and listening skills, including the ability to shape and articulate a clear scientific story.
  • Collaboration: Demonstrated success working with internal and external stakeholders and influencing across cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
  • Execution: Proven strategic thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, project management, and prioritization skills. Self-directed, adaptable, and comfortable in a dynamic environment.
  • Integrity and compliance: High personal integrity, sound judgment, and emotional intelligence, with an understanding of the legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements of the biopharmaceutical industry.
  • Patient focus: Strong commitment to patient needs and advancing scientific understanding within the CTCL community.

Location, Travel, and Work Environment

  • Remote, field-based position supporting an assigned US geography.
  • Frequent domestic travel by ground and/or air is required (60% or more), depending on territory size, stakeholder needs, congress participation, and business requirements.
  • Ability to attend local, regional, and national meetings, including occasional evening or weekend programs, as business needs require.
  • Ability to work effectively from a remote office and manage a geographically dispersed territory.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

  • A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
  • Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
  • A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
  • Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $215,000 - $230,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access this website to apply for a vacancy as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to .

Know Your Rights

At Sobi, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion creates stronger teams. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective and experiences could be exactly what we need. We look forward to hearing from you!

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of people who live with a rare disease. Our edge comes from our team of people and our commitment to patients.

Our mission and culture at Sobi North America get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

  • Competitive compensation for your work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Opportunity to broaden your horizons by attending popular conferences
  • Emphasis on work/life balance

  • Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

raw.description:
The Data Analyst for Value-Based Insights (VBI) is responsible for transforming Medicare (CMS) claims data into metrics, benchmarks, and measures that power WellSky's VBI product for Home Health and Hospice providers and payers. This role builds and maintains claims-based data extracts and performance measures, translates CMS methodologies and regulatory rules into production analytics, and partners with product and engineering to deliver trusted, data-driven insights. The work is retrospective, methodology-driven, and directly tied to how agencies measure and improve value-based performance.

Location: This is a remote position. Candidates located within 50 miles of WellSky’s headquarters in Overland Park, KS will join our WHQ community and participate in our in-office collaboration experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain claims-based data extracts and measures from CMS data sources, including the Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW) and Limited Data Set (LDS), to support VBI Home Health and Hospice solutions.
  • Develop and maintain performance measures such as HHVBP claims-based measures, MSPB-PAC, Functional Items, hospitalization/ER/PPH/DTC rates, utilization and efficiency metrics, length of stay, and composite/percentile scores.
  • Interpret CMS regulations and annual Final Rules (e.g., HHVBP methodology, eTPS calculations) and translate measure specifications into accurate, reproducible SQL logic.
  • Write and optimize SQL against large claims datasets in BigQuery; contribute to data pipelines, quarterly lookup-table refreshes, and extract automation.
  • Produce referral pattern, competitive analysis, market/benchmark extracts, and validate outputs against CMS public benchmarks (e.g., Home Health Compare) and client expectations.
  • Investigate data quality issues and metric discrepancies, and document methodology, data sources, and assumptions so results are auditable and repeatable.
  • Prepare data for downstream BI/visualization layers (e.g., Sisense) and collaborate with product managers and engineers to define technical requirements and analytical interpretations.
  • Perform other job duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:  

  • Bachelor's degree in quantitative, health-informatics, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in data analysis, with demonstrated proficiency in SQL against large, complex datasets.
  • Direct experience working with Medicare/CMS claims data (e.g., CCW, LDS, LDS/RIF files, or comparable claims sources).
  • Comfort with healthcare claims coding structures (e.g., ICD, HCPCS/CPT, revenue codes, DRGs).
  • Ability to translate written specifications or methodologies into analytical logic and validate results for accuracy.

 

Preferred Qualifications:     

  • Knowledge of Home Health and/or Hospice operations, post-acute care, or value-based care programs (e.g., HHVBP, HHVBP eTPS, hospice HIS/HOPE).
  • Experience with CMS quality/value-based program methodologies and familiarity with reading CMS regulations/Final Rules.
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery (or a comparable cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Sisense, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with risk adjustment or benchmarking concepts.
  • Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for data transformation and automation.

Job Expectations:

  • Willing to work additional or irregular hours as needed, particularly around quarterly CMS data refreshes and annual Final Rule cycles.
  • Must work in accordance with applicable security and HIPAA policies to safeguard company and client protected health information.
  • Must be able to sit and view a computer screen for extended periods of time.
